The Mutant Falls are one of the most popular places for Zenzen monks to meditate. That's why you can often find them walking around here. They often sit on large waterlily pads, and try to meditate for as long as possible... without being swept away by the current!
Many monks who fall asleep often fall in and are never seen again.
dialog.help: Ah? Uh ... yes ... can you ... bring me ...Zzzz ... zzz....
dialog.get: Ah? Uh ... yes ... bring me ... a... waterlily.....pad.....
dialog.where: Find ... my ... apprentice padamonk ... Zzz ... zzz....
dialog.give: Thanks... at last...I'll be able to......meditate at... the Falls!!!! I would like to offer you this Pearl as a reward.  It has been added to your collection of items!
dialog.act: Youhouhhh!!! That's amazing! Look... I'm levitating!
dialog.gant: Oooh!!! You have a Zors Glove, that's incredible!
dialog.why: Let me explain. The Zors glove has the ability to stop the Falls from flowing. This means that, with the help of the waterlily pad, you'll be able to go around the Falls and access Grumhel Forest.
dialog.super: Well, if you promise to let me use your Glove from time-to-time, I lend you my waterlily pad which will allow you to pass through the Falls ... Do we have a deal?
dialog.ok: Here's your waterlily pad ... Now you'll be able to pass through the Falls. Good luck for the rest of your adventure! And take care, the Forest is very dangerous!

dialog.begin: Hello! I'm Damper, padamonk of Master Hydargol. I've been sent to fetch these waterlily pads for him. The problem is that, I just realized that I get seasick... and I need to take the waterlily pads to the Atlanteid Islands. I don't know what to do!!!
dialog.help: Really, you'll help me?? Thank you so much!
dialog.get: I'm so glad that I can count on you! Here, take the waterlily pads. Thank you again!

choice.help: I'm going there too. I can take them with me if you would like?

dialog.begin: The Archsage mansion is at the center of the dome. It's an honorary title given to an Archmage who is too old to use his magic powers. Nonetheless, he is a person of great knowledge even if his words are sometimes too difficult to understand.
dialog.enigm: Hello hello! What are you looking for? Do you want something? Maybe I can help you?
dialog.next: Oh! Bravo! Bravo! Thanks, and bravo again! Here's your reward, your Dinoz received a BIG TREASURE!
dialog.tresor: Listen to me OK? I'll tell you how to get what you're looking for. If you bring me everything I need yes, you understand, yes? Now, what do you want to know?
dialog.quoi: Listen. My first is sticky, my second basaltic, my third is pure water. You will need a tool, that yes. A tool to find all. Come back to me and I will give you the treasure, but beware of the danger! F-O-E!
dialog.show: Oh! Bravo! Bravo! Thanks, and bravo again! Here's your reward, your Dinoz received a BIG TREASURE!

dialog.begin: A strange and awkward looking person is hiding behind the trees... He brandishes a lantern and shines it in your direction.
dialog.hi: The man seems very worried and continues to look at you without saying anything...
dialog.approach: You barely take a step in his direction before the man jumps, frightened, into a bush! A moment later, he lifts his head out of the bush and looks at you again with a look of anxiety strewn across his face...
dialog.run: You run away as fast as you possibly can!
dialog.ignore: You turn your head to ignore him. But while glancing in his direction,  you notice with surprise that he's now standing right in front of you!  You can't prevent yourself from letting out a cry of surprise! He puts his lantern under your nose and starts sniffing you noisily...
dialog.intro: Scared? Scared of what? The shadows or my voice? You're scared too? We're all scared! I've seen them!
dialog.leave: You step back slowly and move away without looking back...
dialog.seenWhat: Gorgoth! The head eater from the dark abyss!!
dialog.show: It terrorizes every living creature in the Grumhel Jungle!! Look! There it is! (He points to a clearing in the jungle's dense vegetation)!\t
dialog.fight: While you are searching for the strange man, you notice that he has disappeared...\nThe good news is that he dropped his lantern whilst he was running away. You can use this lantern to help guide you in dark places.

choice.leave: Hmm, I have to leave now...
choice.fight: Attack Gorgoth (the head eater from the dark abyss)!

dialog.begin: A recent earthquake has cracked the rock face. An ice-cold wind blows in your direction and you notice a strange man standing nearby, inspecting the crack.
dialog.talk: Pheewww!! Do you see this crack? It opens into an enormous cavern, it's ice-cold inside! Hey! Be careful! If your Dinoz enters the cavern he'll be frozen immediately!
dialog.gla: You see!! It's cold around here... According to my thermodynamic studies, the hot magma flows from the Big All-Hot and the heat is absorbed from the supra conductive rocks. This creates a strange cooling effect through convection. In effect, it's a natural fridge inside!
dialog.ok: Isn't it!? I often explore the caverns and other strange underground lairs. That's my job, I'm a popotholeler! I got my degree in Speleleology from Dinotown University!
dialog.ok2: Right?? I came here immediately after I heard about the earthquake. It seems I was the first person to discover this cave! I've already given it a name: The Relative Zero Cave! What do you think?
dialog.ok3: Thanks! As you've been so nice to me, I'll give you a little tip. If you put your Dinoz in the Relative Zero Cave, he'll be frozen...
dialog.congel: Yup! Fro-zen! But the good thing is that the temperature is not so low that it will kill your Dinoz. It will only freeze it temporarily! You won't be able to use this Dinoz anymore. But it will not count in your Dinoz LIMIT. So you can have MORE Dinoz! But you'll have to keep an eye on the side effects...
dialog.congel2: Yes, from the moment your Dinoz is frozen, it will not count towards your LIMIT. You will only be able to defrost it if you are under the LIMIT. This means that you will have to freeze another Dinoz for this one to take its place... your Dinoz will take one full day to defrost, you will have to be very patient... do you understand?
dialog.thanks: You're welcome! Don't hesitate to call me if you need any help exploring any mysterious underground lairs!
dialog.bye: Bye! And make sure you don't come too close to this crack!

dialog.begin: Ah! Hello, It's you! It's very cold isn't it?
dialog.talk: I just spent some time in the Relative Zero Cave ... did you know how complex the ice inside is? It's composed of 3% of Solid Nitrogenious, a rare ingredient which keeps the temperature stable...
dialog.next: This means that the ice doesn't defrost, even during the summer when magma flows slowly down the cave. Solid Nitrogenious goes against all the rules of thermodynamics, this is why it's so confusing for the University professors.
dialog.prof: Yup! Some intellectuals, such as the famous Professor Eugene have put forward a theory explaining the existence of Solid Nitrogenious. It's extremely complicated as it requires one to consider that the Universe is composed of 4,24 dimensions: 3 dimensions for the normal world and 1,24 dimensions used only by the Solid Nitrogenious.
dialog.theo: Crazy right? But this theory is very useful. It can be used to predict the boiling temperature of an Archelion. It's main flaw is that it predicts the existence of a Parallel Dark World to Dinoland ... the scientific community believes that Professor Eugene is wrong as it's simply not possible for a place such as this to exist. Well, at least according to Professor Stinstanstein's theory.
dialog.ok: In any case, the ice here is awesome! Here, take this small piece, keep it with you to refresh yourself when you're hot!

dialog.begin: You come across a strange and menacing Dinoz. It's staring at you intensely with its red eyes, it seems really fierce!
dialog.fight: You have defeated a Pteroz and earned the Pteroz Trophy. This will allow you to buy Pteroz in the Dinoz Shop. Congratulations!
dialog.leave: Phewww! One more step and this Dinoz would have attacked you!

dialog.begin: You come across a strange Dinoz. As it spots you, it starts running away. What do you do?
dialog.fight: You've defeated a Hippoclamp and earned the Hippoclamps Trophy. This will allow you to buy Hippoclamps in the Dinoz Shop. Congratulations!
dialog.leave: It seems like it's not coming back... What species could it be?

dialog.begin: A strange stone is standing in your way. It seems like a very odd location for a stone... What do you want to do?
dialog.touch: That's strange... this stone seems to be warm but there's nothing else special about it. Maybe it would be better to leave it alone...
dialog.leave: You're right, it's only a rock....
dialog.fight: Oops!! It seems that this stone was in fact a Rocky, a half-animal half-mineral Dinoz rarely found in Dinoland... By defeating it, you've earned the Rockies Trophy, which will allow you to buy Rockies in the Dinoz Shop. Congratulations!

dialog.begin: Hello youngster, I've been waiting for you...

Hey there young master! Welcome to the Lavapit... capital of the Big All-Hot... Don't hesitate to admire our magnificent basalt sculptures. There are magma baths here too. Relax, chill out. If you're hungry why don't you try our local specialty: Goblin Merguez... It'll give you a little boost, give it a try... You'll see.
dialog.charm: Oh yeah, that's right. Take this, it's a Fire Charm ... it'll help your Dinoz in the upcoming battles.
dialog.boost: Stay here, I will enchant your Dinoz with Shaman magic ... Oyeee, oyeee! ZZZZzzzzzz... ... It's done, you can go, your Dinoz is stronger now.
dialog.nothing: Hey, don't try to scam me, your Dinoz already has a charm ... Come back later.
dialog.vener: Uhmm ... ? The Venerable? ... He's a real grouch... he nearly ate me yesterday just because he said I was being annoying and disturbing his sleep. WHAT?! You really want to visit the Venerable? Bah ... do what you want ... take the path on your right at the Forges, and it's straight ahead.
dialog.force: Strong? Who? The Venerable? Yeah he's strong. He's listed as the most common cause of death for tourists, just ahead of heart attacks caused by our Goblin Merguez ... Ha ha, these tourists are so delicate!
dialog.souvenir: Some souvenirs? ... Bah ... I've got a pile of incantation pages here, but I don't know if you're interested in them ... I can also give you an autograph if you want, I'll sign it using my real name, Bomer Boof... Interested? No? I didn't think you would be, not many people are. If you're really looking for some souvenirs you should go to the Forges ... there's a lot of combat gear there... maybe you'll find something interesting.
dialog.more: Uhmm.... If your Dinoz agrees to fulfill a few missions for me, I'll entrust him with my Strategy Guide. It's very useful...

choice.souvenir: Can I buy souvenirs in the area?
choice.charm: I have been told of a charm...
choice.merci: Thanks, I'll take your advice into account!

intro.go: Pheeww! It's better to be careful when around strangers, you never know what's going to happen...
intro.talk: What? You can see me? .... Argh! ....
intro.yes: The guy who sold me this cape assured me that it would make me invisible! Can you take a look at the indicator on my back, is something written on it?
intro.read: What? \"LOW BAT-RICE\" ? Umm... the seller told me to recharge something... so I have to use... rice? But where can I find rice?
intro.talk2: Hurry! I NEED the rice to recharge my cape. Quick! Hurry!!

tech.begin: My cape ran out of rice again ... I'm starting to get sick of this...
tech.qual: What!? How dare you talk like that about Caushemesh technology! Do you know how many years of research it took our scientists to master the Ether?
tech.qual2: Instead of saying stupid things, maybe you should try and complete your mission...
tech.caush: Yes! It's the great civilization of the Caushemesh Mountains, far beyond the Magnetic Steppes. We're way more developed than these barbarians from Dinotown...
tech.ether: After centuries of research, the Caushemeshians have mastered the power of Ether, a complex mix of the Air and Void elements. It's an extraordinary technological advancement, all thanks to Caushemesh engineers, the best in Dinoland!
tech.next: Your Dinoz are too weak. They're no match for ours, hahahaha! Make sure you train your Dinoz well, as the day will come when you are called upon to fight more powerful enemies!
tech.more: Enough of me talking... what would you say about a little mission to convince you of the strength of our technology?

reward.begin: I thought I should let you know that all the Dark Dinoz you have met up until now were only newbies that we train in this region of Dinoland... the Dinoz of Caushemesh are far stronger. Even your Venerable will be no match for our strongest Dinoz masters!
reward.next2: I'm a man of my word. Here's a reward to convince you of the superiority of Caushemesh technology. I only have one, so use it well... it's a bracelet made of Tik, you can equip it on the Dinoz of your choice...

magnet2.view: Before you have approached, the Prowler has mysteriously disappeared. What is he up to....

magnet12.ask: Yes! More than foiling my plan, you've pursues me and now you think you can stop me?
magnet12.euh: I won't forget about this! Now I have to return to report to the Caushmesh Masters ... You're lucky I'm in such a hurry, next time we meet, I'll make you pay for your acts!
magnet12.end: The Prowler has mysteriously disappeared ... he seemed extremely angry with you....

afterSpy.begin: Now freed from his spying obligations, the prowler has settled down not too far from dinoplaza. He's relaxing in the sun, fanning his toes in the breeze... Better to see him here than conjuring up some elaborate swindle...

choice.go: This guy seems dangerous... it's probably a good idea to move away from him.
choice.qual: It's probably a bad quality cape...
choice.qual2: It's probably a bad quality cape...

dialog.begin: GWWWWWWWWAAAAAAARGGGGGGGHHHHHH!!!! Whoooooo dares to waaaake me up from my naaaap?????
dialog.bye: You're right, there are times in life when it's better to leave quickly and quietly rather than being brave...
dialog.moi: UUUHMMMM?? What do you want!? I hope you have a good reason for being here, or else I'll COOK your Dinoz and have it for BREAKFAST!!!
dialog.korgon: UHHMM??? A KORGON, you say??? Where? I'm hungry, bring it to me!!
dialog.next1: Oohhh! It got away? That's so IRRITATING! Don't worry, I can sympathize. In my youth, I often let breakfast escape from me like that. Now I GRILL them immediately, so they don't have time to escape!
dialog.fight: GROOOOAAARRH!!! You may have won THIS time! BUT we WILL meet again!
dialog.moi2: UHMMMM? I remember your Dinoz. What else do you want from me?
dialog.question: So, Korgon eater, can I GRILL something for you? Or maybe I can do you another favor? Don't ask for too much, or else I'll CUT you into small crispy pieces. That would be perfect for my BREAKFAST!!!
dialog.force: UHHMM??? Stronger you say? Well then, you should follow my advice. Go talk to the SHAMAN at Lavapit, he'll help you GRILL your enemies!
dialog.fight2: UHMM... I'm starving at the moment, would you mind if I did it later???

choice.perdu: I got lost coming here and...
choice.chasse: I'm a Great Dorogon Hunter. I've come here to challenge you!
choice.deal: I have a GOLDEN business opportunity for you!
choice.korgon: I was running after a Korgon and...
choice.question: Uh...
choice.force: I'd like my Dinoz to be stronger!

dialog.begin: GRRrrrr....Grouph...Croaakkk.....I'm still waiting for your help. I'm counting on you.
dialog.ok: You leave, having made up your mind to save the venerable.
dialog.force2: UHHMM??? Stronger you say? Well then, you should follow my advice. Go talk to the SHAMAN at Lavapit, he'll help you GRILL your enemies!
dialog.comb: Well done, you are ready to challenge the dorogons on Nimbao.
dialog.ko2: Well done, you are ready to challenge the dorogons on Nimbao. Good luck!

choice.ko: I need to get in shape!
choice.ko2: I need to get in shape!
choice.force2: I'd like my Dinoz to be stronger!

dialog.begin: Sur le bord d'une rue, vous rencontrez un Soldat Blessé. Il a l'air vraiment mal en point, mais il est encore conscient.
dialog.no: You don't stop, but instead keep walking, it's dangerous to talk to strangers!
dialog.give: .....yum.....yum...THANKS!!! I feel much better already, you're my saviour!
dialog.derien: WAIT!!! I want to reward you! You see, I wasn't always like this. I took part in special training at the Lavapit Caves. It's very hard and very expensive, but it makes you very strong. HERE! Take this Membership Card for your Dinoz, I don't need it anymore...

choice.give: Give the soldier a warm bread
choice.derien: Please, don't mention it. I'm glad you're feeling better!

dialog.begin: Hello, hello, what do you want from me, Master Tamer?
dialog.question: Any questions? Mmmmmmm.... How about a little mission for your Dinoz instead? Some friends and I organize rallies all around Dinoland! You could take part, if you're interested.
dialog.nothing: Really? Well then... Have a good trip!
dialog.quest2:
Come back when you have obtained the Korgon fins from Grumhel Forest.
Then I'm able to fulfill your dearest wish.
dialog.quest3:
A question? Mmmmm... I see that you got the Korgons fins.
That means you should be able to survive... over there... maybe...
dialog.where: Mmmm.... To go there, you will have to gather seven Dinoz. Not necessarily yours, no, they can also be Dinoz of your Clan members. Once there are enough Dinoz, I can send you there...
dialog.where2: Mmm.... It is a place... I can't tell you more about. But know that you'll find a key, yes, THE key for the Blacksilva door. It will allow you to continue your adventure. That is, if you survive.
dialog.how:
How? Mmm... Listen to me. You need to gather seven Dinoz here. Not necessarily yours, no, they can also be Dinoz of your Clan members.
Every Dinoz must concentrate. When you will be seven, then you will be able to go there.
dialog.danger:
Dangerous? Mmm... to make it simple, I would say that you probably have little chance of surviving there...
But like they say: \"Nothing ventured, nothing gained.\""
dialog.concen:
Mmm... Good... I will hypnotize your Dinoz. It'll be able to concentrate better that way...
Don't worry, you can stop this at any time, if you wish.
dialog.quest4:
Any questions? Mmmmm... You're going to need some ingredients if you want me to help you.
Well, if I guess correctly what question you wanted to ask me...
dialog.noingr:
Well well well.... The Coral that never breaks, the Ice that never melts, and the Branch that never fades.
Looks like you're missing something, my friend.
dialog.ingr: Poom poom palalam poom poom pam poom poom palalam PAM! And here you go, a magnificent Anti-SEDH Potion for you...
dialog.potion: Mmmm... goodbye my friend, come back to see me sometime!
dialog.ok: Very well. Your Dinoz closes its eyes and begins to concentrate deeply...

choice.question: I have a question for you...
choice.concen: I want my Dinoz to concentrate!
choice.potion: So you are an Ancient Monkey!!!

dialog.begin: Hi ! You spoke to Mr Bao? He's really aaaaaawesome, isn't he???
dialog.ok: Hey, it's true!! He's so cool! I even crossed the Forest of Grumhel on purpose so that he would tell me lots of great stories! You know what, he knocked out a demon gorilloz once! Yes ! And he was surrounded by all kinds of angry animals! And you know what? Well, he beat them all!
dialog.wah: Yeah! He even agreed to teach me a few things! He said that I'm really gifted for my age! That's good, isn't it? Wait, look, I can enchant something for you. Wanna see?
dialog.yes: .............. Here, I finished it. Do you want it? Take it... it's a Bao Charm! Be careful with it, OK? It should help your Dinoz during battles. Once all the spiritual fluid has run out, you can come back here and I'll recharge it for you!
dialog.spirit: Yeah, sorry, that's right. \"Spiritual\" Ah, these technological words are so difficult to pronounce!
dialog.thanks: Oh no! You're leaving already, that's a shame. You have to come back again, hopefully I'll see you soon.
dialog.nothing: It seems your Dinoz already has a Bao Charm! Look, it still has some energy left. When it runs out I can recharge it for you.
dialog.no: Oh really? Well it's your loss. *sulk*.

choice.thanks: Well, I have to go now. Thanks a lot for the Bao Charm, it was really kind of you!

dialog.begin: Hello Tamer... Don't make a sound, you mustn't disturb the Korgons!
dialog.korgons: Yes, they are these little creatures that live here. Be careful around them! Make sure to never look them directly in the eyes... And if one of them gets too close, you can always try to give him a piece of wood to nibble on, that should calm them down.
dialog.why: They might take that for a challenge! You can imagine what would happen if all the Korgons from the camp think you have offended them.... The last person who made that mistake ended up as Korgon dinner!
dialog.wood: They love it! This is also the reason why they settled in the Grumhel Forest. Fascinating, isn't it? But unfortunately for us, they are capable of eating everything and anything, clueless travelers included.
dialog.tame: A long time ago, I think the Korgons were domesticated. Probably long before Jazz Island collapsed... But today, they have reverted to their wild state! There is no way to approach them without the risk of losing an arm. A few Tamers have tried, but no one has gotten more than a big bite.
dialog.interest: Isn't it?! I'm glad to see you like these adorable Korgons so much! If that interests you, you could do a few little tasks for me at the Camp?
dialog.service: Perfect! This is what you can do...

choice.why: We should not look at them?

dialog.begin: A man dressed in safari clothing is standing at the Edge of the Grumhel Jungle. He seems to be waiting for something...
dialog.welcome: Grumhel Jungle! This wild yet tranquil place is protected from aggressors by its dangerous wildlife. Today the Jungle has a mysterious aura that charms hundreds of explorers every year! Thrill sequence. \"Discovering a Wild World\", it's today, in my company!
dialog.who: Nicolas Mulot! Journalist for Ouïaïa magazine and lover of Dinoland!
dialog.role: Not for an extreme journalist like me. I'm here to discover all things wild!  An undiscovered world, beautiful wildlife, wondrous plants in all their glory, there are so many fabulous things to discover at every turn!
dialog.myst: I don't know for the moment... But... I am sure that there are a lot of fabulous things hidden in this jungle! You just have to be daring enough to enter...
dialog.flora: The beauty of these millennium trees is hidden to most, but for those who know where to look, they're a sensual delight. Exotic scents, multicolored flowers, luxurious vegetation, Grumhel Jungle really is a wonder of Mother Nature!
dialog.whynot: Let's just say that there are some pretty dangerous plants in the jungle... like the \"Black Virulent Toxicae\" or the \"Giant Liver-Eating Lily\"...
dialog.fauna: Between Bramble Eaters, Korgons and Tawny-Bats. The Grumhel Jungle contains many hidden dangers beyond your wildest dreams! Much like Hostile Land and Promised Land, this part of Dinoland cannot be so easily travelled....
dialog.fear: I think it would be a good idea to first plan a reconnaissance mission before choosing to delve into depths of Grumhel Jungle!
dialog.explore: That would be an excellent idea! The jungle is difficult to explore single-handedly, a helping hand would be very welcome indeed. Thanks young man!
dialog.other: Are you sure you want to enter the mysterious Grumhel Jungle?
dialog.sick: While Nicolas Mulot is talking you notice, with horror, that his face is puffing up and is beginning to become covered with warts and spots!!
dialog.problem: Ehmm ... Hellow. I don't meen two bwe roode, but I fink that the plwaants you have bwought were a bit... ehmm tofic ... I fink fhat my plwaant allergies are plwaying up ... Can you maybe felp me to fwind a rwemedy? ...
dialog.sickstatus: So, have you fwound a rebedy?
dialog.better: The remedy you gave me worked perfectly!

choice.better: You seem to be much better...
choice.role: Isn't it a bit dangerous for a journalist to be here?
choice.myst: What kind of mysteries exist here?
choice.fauna: Tell me about the Jungle wildlife...
choice.flora: Are there nice plants around here?
choice.fear: Ah ... you're scared? Is it that you don't want to enter the jungle alone?
choice.whynot: Why haven't you entered the jungle then?
choice.explore: I can help you if you want?
choice.problem: Oh, my! What happened to you?

dialog.begin: You're standing in front of an enormous tree. It's ancient but very wise. Slowly but surely, the trees' leaves start to rustle and move in your direction.
dialog.shake: While shaking the tree (if it is at possible to shake such a big tree), you hear a strange growl coming from inside the bark! Something falls suddenly from the leaves and hits you on the head... Plunk!
dialog.item: It's a big hazelnut wrapped inside a scroll. To your surprise, you find that something written on the scroll!

dialog.begin: Oh oh oh oh oh oh oh! Your Dinoz seems to be in a bad state!!
dialog.arg2: What? Me? Excuse me! A bit of respect please! You won't last long here if you keep saying silly things like that! I'm a SKELETON thank you very much! A skeleton yes! I may look a bit dishevelled, but I'm no ghost!!!
dialog.diff: First of all, a ghost is dead, and me, I'm just... a bit tired, I must have rings under my eyes, that's all... a ghost haunts people. Me? I'm free to do what I please!... well almost...
dialog.free: It's a bit ... mmmm ... complicated ... I have a few technical problems to resolve. Firstly, only Dinoz close to death and their masters can see me, secondly I can't leave this shady place...
dialog.haunt: Haunt this place?!? You must be joking! Ooooooooo! Just imagining it gives me the creeps! I have much more important things to do!
dialog.do: Erm... That's... INSTRUSIVE! Oh oh oh oh!... But I'll tell you anyway (maybe one more time) ! Oh oh..... You see... I have a LOVER! It may seem weird to think that but when I was much younger, I had wonderful shins!
dialog.uhm: I promise! It doesn't matter anyway, I've got a skeleturse that will make you forget everything about me!
dialog.bonne: Yes, oh oh oh oh! It's like a curse but better! I'm protected by this skeleturse. It helps to prevent nightmares and to keep scientists away. They'd be all too happy to see how I feed, oh oh oh! I don't even care about my cholesterol anymore. Anyway, people forget about me as soon as they look away from me!
dialog.next: Exactly! I can't leave this place, so I have no way of finding him, my LOVELY Moulder!
dialog.nohelp: You can't help me anyway! Leave me alone. I'm going to sit here and think about him, don't forget to forget me!
dialog.forgot: You are certain that you were just talking to someone, but you can't remember who or what you were talking about. Very strange, you feel like you've just seen a ghost! No, that's not possible.
dialog.help: REAAAALLYYYY!? OH OH OH OH OH!! You would do that for meeeee? It's not going to be easy, and every time you see me you'll forget our meeting instantly! Are you sure you want to help me???
dialog.accept: OH OH OH OH OH!! Then please, Dinoz Master! Help me find Moulder and I'll handsomely reward you!
dialog.unlocked: Oh oh Oh Oh OH! The skeleturse has been lifted! Now you can help me find Moulder!
dialog.endBegin: Thanks for all your help! Moulder and I now live happily in this magnificent location with a glorious sea view! We're so happy together! We can't thank you enough!
dialog.dinoz: Don't be so modest! We wouldn't be back together if it wasn't for you and all your help. Come back to me when you have more Dinoz. I'll give you a gift that will help you in your future quests!
dialog.pda: Don't be so modest! We wouldn't be back together if it wasn't for you and all your help! Here this is for you ... take this Planner. It'll help you handle many Dinoz. It will be added to your collection of items. Make sure you take care of it!
dialog.bye: The scary skeleton looks at you, disappointed. You could turn back and see that she is close to tears, but you continue to run away as far as possible.

choice.free: Almost free? What does that mean?
choice.haunt: So you do haunt this place?!
choice.next: It's not very helpful, is it?
choice.question: I won't forget anything!

dialog.begin: Mmmm.... These Napalm Shrimp smell delicious! They remind me of my wife's cooking!
dialog.you: Yes I am! Pleased to meet you! Did you know that there are strange burned circles in the ruins? I've studied these phenomenons for a long time and have come to a conclusion: there are two explanations for these strange marks...
dialog.explain: They may have been made by strange creatures from outer space who landed in remote places to study the human kind. It could be that they create these strange burned circles when they return to their own planet! The King may be hiding this information because he is plotting with them! Amazing, isn't it?
dialog.other: Mmmmm, the other explanation seems to be far less plausible, but according to the Merguez Seller, the strange burned circles may be caused by tourists who set campfires when they visit the ruins. I know! Crazy idea, isn't it?
dialog.ok: Mmmm....these Napalm Shrimp are delicious! And to think that I will never see my lovely wife again! We were so in love... I miss the little cries she would make when I came back from a boozy happy hour with my colleagues... And to think that she's probably dead...
dialog.ok2: What? I hope you're joking. I'm still in my youth! Look how smooth my bones are: no wrinkles! Ah ah ah ah ah!
dialog.exp: ............. Thanks! That means I was right all along and I did well not to look for another wife to take her place! I can't thank you enough, you have no idea what this means to me!
dialog.end: Don't be stupid! This would never have happened if it wasn't for you! Guide me to my wife. I'm longing to see her again, I can't wait to look into her beautiful eyes!!

choice.skully: Skully is searching everywhere for you...

dialog.begin: While passing through BrutForce, you meet a woman, who just seems to be waiting for you.
dialog.talk: Well, if it isn't the young Dinoz Master I've been hearing so much about. Grandpa Joe speaks very highly of you, did you handle his missions that well?
dialog.talk2: Since you seem to be someone who can be trusted, I'd also like to entrust you with a few missions, it's up to you whether you accept or not!
dialog.question: Who I am?!? Ah ah ah! Forgive me, my young friend, I completely forgot to introduce myself! I am.... .... ....
dialog.question2: ... sorry... I apologize. I just remembered that I can't reveal who I am, because that might get you in big trouble! But I want to assure you that you can trust me, therefore I'm going to tell you something interesting...
dialog.double: Let's see... I assume that so far you have learned that each skill corresponds to a single element among the five possible elements? For example, Wrath corresponds to the Fire element and Perception corresponds to the Water element.
dialog.double2: Well... that's not completely true ! There are special skills, which are associated with not just one but TWO elements! A double skill can be learned from either of the two elements that make it up, but requires prior knowledge of a specific skill from each of the two elements.
dialog.double3: I completely understand your surprise, it's a well-kept secret. However, to be able to learn these skills, it is necessary to master Double-Skill, a secret skill that only Drag.... but I have already said too much!
dialog.learn: Oh, it's pretty simple, look, I just have to do 'this' and...
dialog.dolearn: Wow! It worked! You see how easy it is? Your Dinoz has now mastered Double Skills, congratulations!
dialog.no: No... it doesn’t work... if it tingles when I do 'that' or if your Dinoz hasn't yet learned the skills allowing you to master Double-Skill, it won't work. Come back to me later to try again!
dialog.already: What do you think? .... It seems to me that you've already learned! Ha ha ha!

dialog.begin: You've heard about the Elemental Master during your Dinoz Master studies. He's a very well-respected Master, an expert in the comprehension and manipulation of the elements. Young Dinoz Masters can only wish to be taught by him, but he is known for being rude and unapproachable....
dialog.talk: Huh? Who's this? Another nuisance no doubt. I'm starting to get sick of these situations .... go on then boy, SPEAK! .... WHAT DO YOU WANT?
dialog.ask: Of course you want to improve, everyone wants to improve, but no one is willing to put in the effort required. Everyone wants to suddenly improve, but without lifting a finger. If you want my advice, put some effort in!!
dialog.ask2: Mmmm .... insistent aren't you? Let's see .... if you really want to improve you must be willing to work. Only then will I decide if you're worthy of my advice?
dialog.talk2: How is your training coming along? I'm afraid we can't do anything with that.
dialog.talk3: Your training is complete .... I'm not one to give out compliments, but most Dinoz can't complete it, so you're not doing that badly.
dialog.maudit: What? A curse? Don't tell me that you played with my Cursed Wooden Wand? I told you not to touch it!
dialog.maudit2: Typical, now that you've made this stupid mistake, you want my help! As if that's the only thing I have to do! In any case .... what's done is done .... to remove the curse, you must use Devil Ointment. There is a small problem though, the shop that was selling it has gone bankrupt....
dialog.maudit3: However, I've heard tales that a hidden shop exists. This hidden shop is said to sell very rare objects. The prices are very high due to the rarity of the items, but in this instance it seems you don't really have a choice.
dialog.maudit4: According to rumours, only the cursed who venture to the Ashpouk Ruins are able to see the shop....
dialog.sphere: You want a reward!? ..... yes it's true you have shown perseverance in your training in each of the five elements ... perseverance in stupidity! But ok, I give in, why not....
dialog.sphere2: As a teacher, I hope that you have learned something, and that from now on you will be thankful towards those who take their time to teach you new skills,paticularly towards me!
dialog.sphere3: Ah! At least, you're being polite towards me! People are less and less polite these days, it truly is a rare quality ... you know what? I'm going to reward you for your efforts. Do you know what an Elemental Sphere is?
dialog.sphere4: .... as I expected ... why is it that I always have to explain myself to you! An Elemental Sphere is a magical item which has been charged with the power of an element.
dialog.sphere5: There are five varieties of sphere, one for each of the elements. When a Dinoz absorbs one, he will learn a new skill which is directly linked to this element .... it's fair to say that a Sphere is a powerful item.
dialog.sphere6: Wait! that's not all! By accumulating many spheres of the same element, your Dinoz can learn more powerful skills! This means that there are 3 Sphere Levels for each element, making 15 Sphere Skills in total .... do you understand? I can't tell.
dialog.sphere7: Well done! If you understand, I'll give you one of my Spheres! But, as my Sphere Chest is not very tidy, I'm not sure which one I'll end up giving you.
dialog.end: Your Sphere is very precious, you must be absolutely certain before you use it. There are many Dinoz Masters throughout Dino Land who would pay for your Sphere, you can sometimes find them on sale at the Market Place!

dialog.begin: An old man sits motionless, meditating in a corner. He watches you closely while fiddling with his thin goatee... Watching you wander around seems to amuse him greatly...
dialog.talk: You're not ready yet, you insolent youngster.
dialog.talk2: I see you enjoy fighting, young apprentice...
dialog.ouep: Haha, your enthusiasm reminds me of my youth. I used to defeat monsters in the Steppes with my bare hands to toughen myself up...
dialog.insol: I can see disbelief and doubt in your eyes... or perhaps it's boredom! Too bad for you.
dialog.hm2: Well, well, your heart seems pure. You have no doubts. You must be ready to build your Dojo.
dialog.dojo: Yes, with my help, you'll be able to build your Dojo wherever you choose, anywhere in Dinoland. This place of meditation and training will allow you to challenge other Dinoz Masters who roam these lands. You'll also be able to participate in the Inter-Dojo Tournament, a competition that will prove your worth and courage for all to see.
dialog.va: Choose a place where you'd like to build it. You can always come back to me if you need my help. Now, go...
dialog.bien: You stride away with determination. Are you ready to face the challenges that await you?
dialog.aide: You need my help... What a respectful request. What can I do for you?
dialog.aideurl: You can check the help section to learn more.
dialog.maitre: Indeed, I raise some fascinating creatures that I alone have managed to tame. If your Dojo becomes one of the most famous in Dinoland, you will have proven your worth, and I shall reward you with one of the Dinoz in my possession.
dialog.noaide: You walk away. It seems the Dojo holds no more secrets for you.
dialog.dinoz: You'll find out soon enough. Just remember that even if you can't see them, it doesn't necessarily mean they don't exist...
dialog.sustense: The old master watches you walk away with an amused smile...

choice.ouep: I'm training to become the best!
choice.va: What do I need to do to build my Dojo?
choice.aideurl: Could you explain a bit more about the Dojo?
choice.maitre: Are you a Dinoz Master too?
choice.dinoz: What kind of Dinoz are they?

dialog.begin: Oh la la! My merguez are extremely fatty! It was quite an odd idea to come and start selling merguez in such a dark and gloomy place? But those Ruins are absolutely magnificent! I'm certain that one day, millions of tourists will come and visit!
dialog.ah: Yes, that's right! It's a bit like the Acre-o-Poles: my cousin makes a fortune there selling temple-shaped key rings. So I decided I would be the first merchant to set up shop at these magnificent ruins, even though it may take many years for my business to take off, I'm not going to let this golden opportunity pass by!
dialog.ok: Take these Merguez. Your Dinoz is far too skinny! This one's on the house, as long as you do me a favor: promise me you'll tell your friends about the Ashpouk Ruins. Tell them all that I sell the best Merguez around. Promise me you won't forget?
dialog.thanks: You're welcome, don't forget to tell all your friends!
dialog.ok_card: Ah, a loyal customer! With your Merguez Card, I can give you 100 of them straight away. Enjoy!
dialog.thanks_card: With that many, you've got enough to turn the battlefield into one giant barbecue.
dialog.begin_merguez: I've got a challenge for you: use my merguez sausages in battle. Prove your loyalty, and you'll earn a very special card.
dialog.merguez_step_1: Well? Have you started using my merguez sausages? They're supposed to sizzle in battle, not sit in your bag!
dialog.merguez_step_2: Not bad at all! You're starting to understand the power of merguez. Keep it up, you're getting close to the real reward.
dialog.merguez_step_3: Now it's time to prove yourself. Keep using merguez sausages in battle, and come back when you're a true regular.
dialog.merguez_step_4: Incredible! You've proven your loyalty to the mighty merguez. Here's your loyalty card: with it, I can give you 100 sausages at once!

choice.how: And how do I find these stars?

intro.begin: . . . . . me . . . lost . . . . . without power . . stars . . . . never . . . . be able to go .... home . . . . help me?
intro.no: It's better not to get involved with people who look like that!
intro.yes: . . . . . Thanks  . . . . a lot . . . Bziiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiit! Ah! Finally! My simultaneous translator is fixed! Luckily I had some spare strawberry batteries! Thanks for offering your help my friend!
intro.nothing: But it's all thanks to you! As I just told you, I have a little technicological problem. My (SiAvUaEs) is broken like a nut, and I can't go back to my home, on (PuOsEniLa)!
intro.dom: I need your nice help to recover some (TcEtCiNo) crystals for me... Let me think... How can I describe them in your language? They look like shining stars and seem really savory!
intro.star: Yes! If you bring me exactly seven stars, I'll be able to finish my journey. I'll even reward you with a (CiLoJuAeDa) from my planet!
intro.how: It's relatively easy. All you'll have to do is solve spectacular visions which are listed in the Hitchhiker's Guide to the Eclectic. I'll read you one passage of the book at a time, then you'll have to manifest the rest on your own! Ha!
intro.ah: Hmmmm... well! I'm going to get the Hitchhiker's Guide. Wait here, I'll be back in a minute...

megawolfHint.begin: The Guide says: \"A megawolf is waiting for you at the capital!\"
megawolfHint.et: And? That's all! You'll have to manifest on your own now. Sorry for being so eclectic!

progressHint.begin: Ah! I see that you're progressing with your quest! Let's see what the Hitchhiker's Guide says next...
progressHint.star2: The Guide says: \"The enthusiastic greasy man would appreciate a transported cloud\"... does that mean anything to you?
progressHint.star3: Hitchhiker's Guide, page 879 indent B: \"When you get stuck up to the neck, nothing is better than a nice cake\". Pretty clear, right?
progressHint.star4: I quote: \"The shady hole call will serve you\"... Do you have any ideas??
progressHint.star5: The next one is written in small text. It says : \"The old bones seem to like the view of a... capsicum\", yup... that's what it says... (I think)
progressHint.star6: Erm... Appendix B of the Hitchhiker's Guide : \"Visit the god-man when it will be noon at Pek-1\". Mmmmmmm...
progressHint.star7: The last missing star! The Guide says: \"In the country of Saru, you will return from the dead without any artifice\". Sounds dangerous!
progressHint.end: Your language is a bit strange... I can't make sense of it!

final.begin: .... Yeaaaahh!!! Thanks a lot! I'll finally be able to return to (PuOsEniLa)! I have to hurry while the stars are still aligned with Rochechouart...
final.ok: Can you give me the stars? I'll give you a (CiLoJuAeDa) in exchange, plus a trinket I found in Dinoland!
final.give: The Strange Being runs to some kind of small house, then a big lightning strikes before the house disappears. All that remains are burned traces on the ground and a column of smoke rising far up into the sky... He left you one \"Gold Napodino\" and a strange collectible item...

dialog.begin: Oh, I see that your Dinoz is carrying a cloud burger! Did you know that they're bad for your health? Unless you want your Dinoz to become a Sumo?!?
dialog.ok: Throw away your nasty Burger and taste my merguez instead! Take this item as a sign of loyalty. I found it on the ground!
dialog.star: Great! The merguez seller has given you one of the seven magic stars!

dialog.begin: Oh oh!! What do we have here!!! It's a magnificent \"Capsicum annuum\"! What colors, what odors, it's absolutely beau-ti-ful!
dialog.ok: Thank you so much! In exchange, I'm going to give you this item. I found it while searching for a lost bone! Take it!
dialog.star: Congratulations! Thanks to Skully, you've found the 5th magic star! You only have two more to find!

dialog.begin: What are you doing in my house at this time in the early morning?
dialog.ok: Sorry, I'm not fully awake yet. I had no idea. Here, take this, I've been keeping it for you. I hope it won't cause you any problems...
dialog.star: Bao Bob has entrusted you with the 6th magic star! Only one left!!!

dialog.begin: Hello Grand Dinoz Master! The Great Tournament of BrutForce is open to all those who want to test their Dinoz against other players. Would you like to register?
dialog.yes: Unfortunately, it is specified in the official rules, paragraph 15.48 indent H: Only Dinoz who possess an ancient relic can access to the tournament. It is the only condition of participation ... don't hesitate to come back once your Dinoz has found one. Have a good day and a nice stay in BrutForce!
dialog.ok: Oh! I see that your Dinoz has an Ashpouk Totem! Very well, I'll register it and it will be included on the Tournament fighter list. Have a good day Dinoz Master!
dialog.no: Very well. No one is forcing you to register - especially if your Dinoz aren't ready to fight against stronger opponents. The Tournament can be very dangerous for ill-prepared Dinoz. Have a good day and enjoy your stay in BrutForce!

choice.no: Hmmm, no thanks... I need to train my Dinoz

magnet0.begin: Hello Stranger ... Unfortunately the King can't see you at the moment he's too busy trying to steal some lodestone!

magnet10.begin: Stranger!! Quick! The King is being attacked by strong creatures, they are trying to poison him and take control of the Royal Stone! Can you help us defeat them?
magnet10.fight: You rush to the rescue of the Rocky King...
magnet10.no: Be quick! We really need your help!

magnet1.begin: You explain that you've been attacked by ferocious Wanwans ... After questioning you, the guards finally grant you an audience with the King, his highness Rocky IV.
magnet1.enter: Welcome Dinoz Master ... It appears you are not a native of the Magnetic Steppes. We appreciate you taking such a long journey to come and see us. Please forgive us for not welcoming you with the usual level of hospitality as the rest of our guests, but recent events have left us exhausted.
magnet1.events: It's no secret that the Royal Family controls all of this region. The power was bestowed on us by previous generations of the Grand-Heavy-Sharp, The Lodestone Tamer.
magnet1.magnet: Lodestone is a type of stone which can only be found at the Steppes ... When combined with wind and sand, lodestone can produce electricity!
magnet1.magnet2: In it's natural state, Lodestone is very unstable and hard to control. The Grand-Heavy-Sharp has discovered a perfectly pure stone: The Angel Stone. The heirs to the Royal Family must protect it in order to keep it away of villains.
magnet1.events2: Recently ... someone tried to steal the Angel Stone!!! It's a difficult job, but we must protect it at all costs! The Royal Family's honor is at stake ... Do you understand?
magnet1.me: Hold on! I'm getting there! You see, bandits are running wild in the Lodestone Steppes. We've seen some of them prowling around the castle. They're the same ones which attacked you near the Syphon. They call themselves Team-W.
magnet1.team: Yes ... Team-W are a strange-looking group of nomads who are controlling some Wanwans. We think they are the same ones who tried to steal our Angel Stone. We've sent our soldiers to look for them, and managed to injure their leader, but we don't know where they're hiding....
magnet1.team2: We had to recall our soldiers in order to protect the Angel Stone. We don't know where or when the enemy will strike time ... Can we trust you with finding and destroying Team-W? You'll be royally rewarded for your efforts!
magnet1.refuse: We understand, there's no need to involve you in something which you are not responsible for. We wish you a safe journey in the Magnetic Steppes, come back if you change your mind....
magnet1.accept: Really? You will be of great help to us young Dinoz Master! Our advisors will show you the secret path. This will allow you to access to the Extreme West where the Bandit's lair is located. Our Highness wishes you good luck. We hope to hear some good news soon!
magnet1.leave: One of the King's advisor shows you the path, granting you access to the bandits' lair. He warns you about the dangers which may await you. Be well prepared!

magnet7.begin: You're already back young Dinoz Master? We hope you return with good news...
magnet7.next: Well then! tell us of your travels...
magnet7.talk: You explain to the Rockies King your meeting with the Team-W Captain, his story concerning Bigbeastly's poisoning, and his innoncence for the Lodestone thefts. The King listens to you in silence...
magnet7.cont: Well well... You'll understand if we can't trust these strange people immediately. It requires further investigation. Meanwhile, we'd like you to carry out another service for us, if you have enough time.
magnet7.serv: Yes exactly. A service. These rumours of someone being poisoned worry us greatly. We must be prepared for the worse. If our information is right, it can be SEDH Active.
magnet7.sehd: SEDH is a very strong poison that can only be found at the Magnetic Steppes. It is created by concentrating Scorpwink poison and adding a secret ingredient which activates hidden powers. Our army has been forbidden from producing Sehd, as once activated one can use it to take control of the poisoned man or Dinoz....
magnet7.control: Yes, that's right. Whoever is under control of SEDH Active can't think normally and even betrays his friends... SEDH was banned from the kingdom a long time ago by our ancestors. If it is SEDH Active, we must find out who is producing it and stop them as soon as possible.
magnet7.serv2: We would like you to go and gather some ingredients for us. Once these ingredients have been gathered together, you will be able to concoct an Anti SEDH Potion that will cure the effects of the poison.
magnet7.ingr: Yes. According to our legends, three ingredients are needed: Coral that never breaks, Ice that never melts, and Branch that never fade. Once this three ingredients have been gathered together, you must find an Antique Monkey....
magnet7.sage: It was either an Antique Sage or an Antique Monkey, we can't remember than well. In any case, they are very powerful people who can live for many centuries! We recognise them because of their third eye that they use to look at the other side of Dinoland....
magnet7.face: Yes ... legend tells that Dinoland has another side, a dark side. We call this place the Dark World. No one has ever returned after venturing there ... but Antique Sages (or Monkeys?) can freely travel in the Dark World ... but we doubt this information can be used to find this person....
magnet7.end: Anyway, his Highness is counting on you to gather these three ingredients, find the Antique Monkey, and bring us the Anti SEDH Potion as soon as possible, which will protect us against the poison... As for the nomads, we will investigate and verify their words ... Your audience with the King has ended. Goodbye.
magnet7.bye: You are on the road again for new adventures...

magnet12.begin: Young Dinoz master! We're very happy that this problem has now been solved... we want to thank you for the many services you have done for the Royal Family, whilst risking your own life...
magnet12.not: With these events, we were able to reconcile with the extreme West nomads... We will be more attentive to our distant subjects, because it seems that our mind on them was a bit hasty.
magnet12.not2: We insist that we must reward you correctly. Thanks to you, we've captured some infamous dark Smashrooms who, it seems, were responsible for stealing the Lodestone, making SEDH Active, Bigbeastly poisoning and the Citadel attack ... what a machiavellian plan!!
magnet12.plan: But don't worry, all the suspects have been locked up in our jail, and they won't be released for a long time, you have our Royal word...
magnet12.ok: Well well, as a thank you for all your services, we have prepared a little reward ... a royal one! We hope that you accept it as a sign of our gratitude...
magnet12.accept: Here you go ... we entrust you with this Negative Lodestone Shard. It can cancel the Lodestone effect in certain areas. It's a very rare item and we hope that it helps you in your future journeys.
magnet12.thanks: The Rockies King has entrusted you with the following item: 'The Negative Lodestone Shard'. But what is it used for?

magnet1.again: Can you repeat it for me?
magnet1.me: What's it got to do with me?
magnet1.again2: Can you repeat it for me?
magnet1.accept: Yes! it would be an honour!

magnet12.accept: Of course I accept it, thanks very much!

magnet6.begin: ...Why did you attack us? Were you trying to get your revenge? I thought we already apologised for attacking you?
magnet6.who: Sorry, you're right, I haven't introduced myself. My name is Mulder, I'm the captain of Team-W ... Who sent you and why did you attack us?
magnet6.dont: I see ... you don't want to talk ... you must be one of his spies! I'm going to ask you for the last time: Who sent you? And why are we being targeted by the King?
magnet6.dont2: I see ... if you have nothing to say, leave! We can withstand the King's attacks for months, nothing is going to make us surrender!
magnet6.tell: You spend the next hour telling the captain everything that has happened since you entered the Magnetic Steppes. You tell him about Team-W's attack, the audience with the King and of course the plot to take some Lodestone.
magnet6.hist1: Ah, now I understand. Some days ago, our strongest Wanwan, Bigbeastly - the one you tried to fight outside - was poisoned by a strange substance.
magnet6.hist2: Of course we investigated to see how it happened. We found a secret path during our investigation which led us all the way to the Rockies King's Citadel. That's why we're watching it so closely: we were searching for a way to cure Bigbeastly.
magnet6.hist3: I can swear that we never planned to take any Lodestone. This stone is of no importance for us nomads, we already have everything we right here at the steppes....
magnet6.hist4: We're often treated like thieves, often because people mix us up with the bandits of the Extreme West! We often find them here and end up fighting ... although they hate us, the inhabitants often help us as the King never sends any soldiers here ... they're too scared by the Huge Worm ... It seems the Nomads have been abandoned by the King.
magnet6.hist5: That's everything I have to tell you. Do you need me to repeat it?
magnet6.ask: I'm very sorry for everyhting that has happened ... but you must understand, we have to cure Bigbeastly ... he is getting weaker by the day and we fear the worst for him. You're in contact with the King, do you think you could help us plead our cause? It's simply a big misunderstanding, and he'll be able to help us find the cause of the poisoning.
magnet6.no: I understand ... come back if you change your mind though.
magnet6.yes: ... Really? You'll do that for us, even though we attacked you? ... may the Huge Worm watch over you! Take care, there may be bandits on the road ... we look forward to hearing from you!

magnet7.begin: Have you seen the King? Do you know how to cure Bigbeastly? ... We're all counting on you, make sure youn return with some good news!

magnet11.begin: Thanks for your help... After you left, the dark Smashrooms took Bigbeastly away. It looks like the poison they were using allowed them to control him...
magnet11.ok: They then used Bigbeastly's strength to attack the Royal Citadel and make off with the magnetite... Fortunately we got there just in time...
magnet11.thanks: No problem, that's just how I roll, we couldn't just let Bigbeastly destroy everything. It's all thanks to your potion that we managed to do it...
magnet11.how: We took him back to our campsite. He's in some mess, but he'll make it though... thanks to you...
magnet11.not: It was above and beyond the call of duty. It seems the Great Worm was watching over you... Come and see us any time at the campsite, we'll let you use our secret shop...
magnet11.thanks2: The captain sets off towards the Team-W campsite...

magnet6.tell: Tell him that the Rockies King sent you
magnet6.again: Yes please, I didn't understand a single thing...

magnet11.thanks: Thanks for your help in the battle!

steppes.begin: Leave me alone... I just want to die...
steppes.ask: You can say that again... I had it all! Everything! Everything: wealth, women, fame... The whole world was mine...
steppes.ask2: I'd rather not talk about it anymore............ Argh! If you must know, I lost it all on Warp Street!
steppes.ask3: Yup ... you haven't heard of it? Warp Street is a small street in Dinotown ... it's reserved to the elite. Disguised Products are bought and sold there!
steppes.deriv: Some Disguised Products! You see, when the price of Santaz goes up, the disguised product linked to Santaz goes down. Except, of course, if the price of Feross goes up too, in which case it depends on what the price of Amnesiac Rice was last month ... In any case, you can make a lot of money in a short period of time on Warp Street!
steppes.deriv2: Yes, exactly! Until just a few days ago...
steppes.ask4: It's simple ... I didn't see the real statue crisis coming...
steppes.ask5: Nope! it's not the same. The Dinoland real estate market is booming right now. Mainly due to all the castles that are being built during the Clan Wars! Some people are earning a fortune in a single day!
steppes.ask6: Real statues were the future! Everybody wanted a bust of the Rockies King! But then global warming started to affect the market, Guerilla Piranhoz started to attack the people who were harvesting the clay. This eventually led to the market crashing and me filing for bankruptucy...
steppes.ask7: How much did I lose? Phew! Around 4 billion gold coins.
steppes.ask8: Yep, 4 billion gold coins. I know it seems a lot to someone who isn't part of the elite. But believe me, 4 billions isn't that much...
steppes.ask9: The worst of it is over. I'm going to recover, I'm sure of it! I have a fantastic business idea. It's incredible and it's never been done before, all I need is a partner ... are you interested?
steppes.ask10: Yes, you! You seems to be a powerful and capable Dinoz Master. Here's my offer: you manage the logistical part of the business and I'll handle the sales. Together, we are going to earn millions ... and who doesn't want to earn millions of gold coins?
steppes.ask11: It's simple, here's the plan: Bring me 100 Devourer Seeds. You can find them at the Steppes. It's important that you bring me 100 seeds, no fewer. In exchange, I'll give you a very rare item I found recently. Give me a few days and I'll sell the seeds on Warp Street and we'll then share the profits, what do you think?
steppes.yes: Great! Here's what we'll do next. Go and get the seeds and then come back here? I'll be waiting for you ok?
steppes.ok: Great! Take this, it's the rare item i told you about earlier. We'll meet later in Dinotown, just in time for me to sell the stock!

dinoville.begin: Leave me alone... I just want to die.....
dinoville.ask: Everything was going so well. Everyone was bidding on the seeds, they were so popular.
dinoville.ask2: Some competitors started a vicious rumour that our seeds contained xylophone, a dangerous substance that makes strange noises in your stomach once you've eaten them. The price plummeted and everyone started to panic so i had to sell the rest of the stock at any price I could get...
dinoville.ask3: Take this... it's your share... it's all I managed to save during the panic... 800 treasure notes...
dinoville.ask4: Yes... you can keep the rare item I gave to you... but don't worry about me! I'll find something else to do next, and next time it will work!!!

steppes.ask: You don't seem too well, are you ok?
steppes.ask5: Don't you mean real estate crisis?
steppes.ask6: So what's the real statue crisis?
steppes.ask11: What do I have to do?

dialog.begin: Desert merchants come to the Request Office all the time to post new job offers for passing Dinoz masters. Take a ticket and attempt a mission if you think you're brave enough.

Michael claims he has been hired by the Dinotown Kingdom to guide young Dinoz Masters through their adventures, but the word on the street is that he just likes helping and was never officially hired by anyone. Whatever the truth is, you can rest assured that you can always trust his advice.
dialog.pub:
I can tell you're keen to travel the world.
 If I were you, I'd leave here and go to Frish Port via the Fountain of Youth. You will surely find out some interesting facts about Dinoland...
dialog.p1: Hello Dinoz Master! It seems that your Dinoz is still young .... your best plan would be to journey to the North-East. Find Grandpa Joe, he'll send you on missions which will gain valuable experience for your Dinoz....
dialog.p1b: The missions will also help you to explore the Dinotown Kingdom. There are other regions of Dinoland to explore but we'll deal with that another time. Come back to me when your Dinoz has reached level 5 and I'll explain further!
dialog.p2: Congratulations! By reaching Level 5 your Dinoz has shown how experienced he has become! If you speak to Professor Eugene at the University, he'll offer you two challenges. But be careful. These challenges are quite dangerous. If your Dinoz is not very strong I would wait a while before taking these tests!
dialog.p2b: Once you've earned a reward from Professor Eugene, return here and I'll explain how to use it. Good luck!
dialog.p3: Congratulations! Your Dinoz has obtained the Buoy ... It will enable you to access the Atlanteid Islands! In order to use it go to the Frish Port, which is located to the south, your Dinoz will then be able to swim to the Atlanteid Islands.
dialog.p3b: The Islands are beautiful, you'll see for yourself. But there's more than that: the islands are a great place to get experience. Oh! Don't forget, when your Dinoz reaches Level 7, return to the University and Professor Eugene will send you on a second challenge....
dialog.p4: Congratulations! Your Dinoz has obtained the Climbing Gear... This will enable you to access the Big All-Hot! To use it, it's really easy: travel north to the Precipitous Hills, where your Dinoz will be able to climb up to the Big All-Hot.
dialog.p4b: Although it has a fearful name, the Big All-Hot is actually rather.......welcoming! But don't forget, once your Dinoz reaches the Level 7, return to the University and Professor Eugene will send you on a second challenge.
dialog.p5: I see that your Dinoz is already in possession of the Buoy and the Climbing Gear. These two objects will allow you to access the Atlanteid Islands and the Big All-Hot. Have you visited these two new areas yet?
dialog.p5n: Really? You don't know what your missing ... swim to the Atlanteid islands from the Frish Port or climb from the Precipitous Hills to the Big All-Hot. You must go, you'll be able to carry out loads of new missions!
dialog.p5y: Really? It seems you have the same spirit as the Grand Adventurer! But I still think there are many secrets which you are still yet to uncover.
dialog.secret: Let me see ... Ah! Here's a good example. Did you know that by passing through the little, winding streets of Dinotown's antique market, you can access another part of the kingdom? It's not fully developed yet, so not many people live there. It's called Dinoplaza!
dialog.secret2: I told you there were still a lot of things to discover! Go and visit Dinoplaza! Come back here when you have time!
dialog.p6: Are you bored? Don't worry, I've got a great idea. Go and hunt the Scorpscuba. You'll find clues on how to find it on the Atlanteid Islands. Then you'll gain access to the Underwater Dome where the next mystery awaits you!
dialog.p7: Congratulations! You killed the Scorpscuba! In order to pass through the Mutant Falls, it seems you need a particular item. Maybe the Archsage of the Underwater Dome will be able to tell you more....
dialog.p8: Congratulations! You've found the Zors Glove! Unfortunately it still seems you're missing something in order to pass through the Mutant Falls. Maybe a ZenZen Monk will be able to help you.
dialog.p9: You can now access Grumhel Forest. I hope you carry on your adventures there. Come back to me once you've found the Korgons item.
dialog.p10: The Korgon fins allow you to undertake Bao Bob's challenge. Make sure you prepare well, the mission won't be easy!
dialog.p11: Now that you've obtained the key to the Blacksilva door. You'll finally be able to access the Magnetic Steppes! Many dangers are waiting for you there, I hope you survive them all....
dialog.p12: You are now one of the Grand Adventurers. There still are many secrets hidden throughout Dinoland, but unfortunately I have no more advice for you at this point in time. Come back to me soon, maybe I'll have more information for you!
dialog.p13: Hello Dinoz Master! Oh dear, are we lost? Have you tried going to the forum for help? Hundreds of Dinoz Masters have come before you, you should try to benefit from their experience. One day, it will be your turn to share your knowledge of the DinoRPG universe with others !

choice.secret2: Wow! You're right I never knew that!
choice.lost: I don't know what to do anymore!

dialog.begin:
What do you want, kid?
 Can't you leave us alone? We're trying to have a quiet drink here...
dialog.poivrot:
Hahaha, you're too cute!
 We meet lots of kids like you, full of fire, full of hope, it's hilarious.
 Isn't that right Bao?
dialog.bao:
Everyone gets their chance in Dinoland.
 There is enough room for all the Dinoz Masters, especially the most worthy.
 We never know when the next great war will be declared against the monsters from the Dark World...!
dialog.guerre: It's true, although Dinoland is a magnificent place, that doesn't make the monsters any less dangerous.
dialog.boit: Wow, you're serious! I prefered you before, you we're much more fun, you've changed, kid... hic!
dialog.glop:
No, I mean yes, but he's just joking around!
 ...
 ...
 _(takes Barprop's drink)_
 Well then, dinoz master, what are you waiting for? Why are you not out adventuring yet?
dialog.raison: Yep, you're right... I'm waiting too, hehe... that said, I've been waiting 10 years, it's my other half who isn't happy, huhuhu !
dialog.gloups:
Adventure always arrives when you least expect it!
 ...
 _(CLassssH KABOUMmmmm, WWwwoooooshhhhhhHHHH, Braacckkkk...)_
dialog.explo:
Oh, that?
 It's just the breach at Mutant falls opening...
 Ah, dammit, yeah - I'm supposed to be keeping an eye on that too!
 No time for a drink now (more's the pity) - I won't let my master down... him or his poisoned chalice...
dialog.fightWin:
You know what yanks my chain? These dark monsters are not supposed to be as strong as this...
 I hope that one of the ancient ones hasn't decided to start poking their nose into this world, that would mean there's trouble ahead for sure...
dialog.fin: Let's go then, I'll take you to the Atlanteid Islands and you'll see how we kick monster butt round here!

choice.poivrot: I want to become the most powerful Dinoz Master ever!
choice.bao: Bao? Do you mean THE Bao Bob?
choice.guerre: I did notice that there were a lot of monsters around here.
choice.glop: Did he just say that to me?
choice.raison: I'm waiting for the call of the epic whistle!
choice.gloups: I'm not sure I'll be waiting that long...
choice.explo: Where did that flash come from? And the tremor?
choice.fight: A monster is making trouble at Frish Port!

dialog.begin: There you are, did you get lost? Follow me to the mutant falls, we must close the breach!
dialog.go: The mutant falls are located to the west of the Atllanteid Islands. Good luck!

dialog.begin: Here we are!
dialog.pop:
To the west, via the sticky swamp!
 Watch out, here's another monster from the dark world!
dialog.fightWin:
Well played, you remind me of my younger self...
 Although let's be honest, I'm not as old as Papy Joe...Do you know him?
dialog.papy:
He is an ex-champion of Anguilloz surfing and notorious womanizer, the only keepsake he holds on to from his glory days are his glasses.
 40 years ago, he promised to never shave again, after (according to legend), he bet he could pull a hair out his nose without crying... and lost.
 He is still something of a local celebrity, and a guy that you should definitely get to know and visit regularly. He is kind of a big deal around here.
dialog.papy2: Let's keep moving, we're nearly there!

choice.pop: Where do we need to go?
choice.papy2: I'm going to go and visit him!

dialog.begin: I see you watching me carefully, you must have a few questions about how the fights work, yes?
dialog.baston:
Every attack launched by your Dinoz causes elemental damage, and on every turn, the element changes, so if your dinoz is strong in fire, it will strike with maximum force on its first attack.
 Fire, wood, water, lightning, and finally air, through all the elements, so it is normal that your dinoz attacks vary in strength.
 Only monsters who don't use elemental attacks will always strike with the same force.
dialog.battle: OK, now you know how it works, try to defeat the dark dinoz behind you...
dialog.fightWin:
Haha, don't worry, I'm here to make sure nothing too bad happens to you!
 When you get back to Dinotown, I suggest you go and see Master Zen.
dialog.zenith:
He's a character with a dress sense which is marginally more bizarre than his habit of drinking concoctions brewed from infused leaves...
 He learned an admittedly painful but definitely *unique* martial art from his mother, called *capilotraction*!
 He is trying to promote this art and combat training to Dinoz masters, and he'll help you to set up your own Dojo.
dialog.zenith2: Let's get back on the road.

choice.baston: Does my dinoz always attack with the same power?
choice.battle: OK, I understand a little better now.
choice.fight: But I'm not strong enough! Gulp!

dialog.begin:
Are you ok? Are you following what's happening?
 Always look on the bright side, I'm sure the Soft Shaman will show you how to save your strength.
 That's his speciality...
dialog.shaman:
[Descendant of the "Kuminatcha" tribes, the shaman has some unique powers.
 If you even want to be in with a chance of him helping you, you'll have to be very strong psychologically if you want to survive his famous "Sleep Inducing Chatter".
dialog.gard:
You can't imagine how many random characters we have in these parts.
 OK, that's us nearly at the breach, normally a seal stops these creatures from getting to the surface. However, it's possible that a powerful demon forced the barrier.
 In which case, I must intervene in my official capacity as guardian of Dinoland!
dialog.aura: Yes. Get ready, pressure of this intensity can only be generated by a truly powerful monster.

choice.gard: There are loads of people to go and see!
choice.aura: I can sense a monstruous aura!

dialog.begin: A gigantic monster, resembling an enormous Moueffe emerges from the falls, an evil aura emanating from its dark body.
dialog.taurus:
Finally, some sunshine, there's nothing quite like the light of the world above ground...
 Grugrugru....
dialog.vade: Leave it to me, this one's more than a handful!
dialog.fightWin:
Cough... Grumph...
 Don't think the great Taurus is gone for good, the infernal moueffe, I'll be back... and then..
 Your world will be plunged into a permanent nightmare.
 I'll make myself scarce for the moment though...
dialog.ouf:
Good Riddance!...
 You still have a long way to go, but rest assured, one day you'll be even stronger than me, and then it will be you who saves Dinoland, but in the mean time - get to training, you must focus on becoming harder, better, faster and yes, stronger!
dialog.move: You collapse, exhausted by all these combats. Bao Bobtakes you back to Dinotown. All is once more as it was before, as if nothing had ever happened...

choice.taurus: I can't move, its power is crushing me!
choice.demon: But I want to help! ATTAAAAAAACCCKKK!
choice.ouf: Go back to the dark world, and never come back!

dialog.begin:
Greetings Dinoz master.
 I'm sure you've heard of my sister Irma, but please try not to get us mixed up!
 I'm a lot more powerful, and I'm going to prove it to you!
dialog.suivant: Tempting, but first I need to get rid of these eggs I've been collecting...
dialog.irma:
Humpff, I knew it, that old trout stealing my thunder again...
 She always needs to be the centre of attention.
 She only knows how to make one potion, I've created something infinitely more exciting!
dialog.popo:
I've already told you I'm not IRMA!
 Maybe I won't even sell you any eggs now!
dialog.oeuf:
Very special eggs!
 *Urma's eggs*, beat every other object going in Dinoland!
 You could find an authentic warm bread, a monochromatic, or even a Dinoz inside!
 It's just down to luck whether you find the object of your dreams... or not.
 They only cost *1000 gold coins*!
dialog.oui: Thank you Dinoz master, I hope you find what you're looking for in the egg. Come and see me whenever you like, I'll be here for a while.
dialog.oui3:
Thank you Dinoz master, I hope you find what you're looking for in the egg.
 Come and see me whenever you like, I'll be here for a while.
dialog.bye: You head off, and look back to see Urma rubbing her hands together. You wonder if she's really getting what she wants from her egg sale?
dialog.bof: You head off, but old Urma looks somewhat disappointed, maybe she should have sold potions like her sister?
dialog.soldOut:
Greetings Dinoz master.
 I'm sorry, I've no more eggs to sell you, you have already bought all the eggs I had put aside for you.
 I hope you were lucky enough to find some objects which will be useful in your quest.

choice.suivant: What are you going to do? Turn me into a Wanwan?
choice.irma: Are you Irma? Is it you that makes the potions?
choice.popo: Can you give me some potions?
choice.oui: Did you say 1000 gold coins? That's a bargain. I'll take one!
choice.oui2: I'd like to buy an Urma's egg for 1000 gold coins!
choice.oui3: I'd like to buy 10 Urma's eggs for 10000 gold coins!

unavailable.title: Mission Blocked
unavailable.description: This mission is not accessible to you at the moment, you will have to come back later.

missions.already: A mission is already in progress. You must complete it before accepting another one.

goals.validate: Return to {nameKey} to validate the mission

fish.name: Fresh fish
fish.begin: Madam Squyd, a resident of Dinotown, is looking for fresh fish to organize a dinner with her friends. Can you get her some fish from the Merchant in Frish Port in the south? He has been warned and he is waiting for you.
fish.end: Madam Squyd is really pleased with you, here's your reward!

fishMerchant.name: The Fish Merchant
fishMerchant.text: Hello little one, are you here for the fish? Here you go! Take them to Dinotown before Madam Squyd's party is ruined.

madameSeyche.name: Madam Squyd
madameSeyche.text: Ooooohhhh, thank you! This meal is going to be a success thanks to you! Make sure you return to Grandpa Joe to receive your reward!

validation.name: Grandpa Joe
validation.text: Return to Grandpa Joe to validate the mission.

dog.name: The lost dog
dog.begin: The old lady Ducraft lost her poodle while visiting her son in the Precipitous Hills, can you find him?
dog.end: Argh... That old hag, her time will come! Anyway, this is for you.

jacquelineDucraft.name: Jessica Ducraft
jacquelineDucraft.text: Hello young man! Nioof-Nioof, my lovely little poodle has disappeared! I punished him for an accident and now I can't find him! Please help me find him, I miss him so much! I'm sure he couldn't climb these mountains with his tiny legs, he probably went to the South.
jacquelineDucraft.text2: My dear Nioof-Nioof!!! Please forgive me, I'm sorry for being mean! Thank you so much, young man. Return to that old fuddy-duddy Grandpa Joe to claim your reward!

findNioufniouf.name: Nioof-Nioof
findNioufniouf.description: You've found Nioof-Nioof! Take him back to Lady Ducraft!

kilgou.name: Smashrooms of the Hills
kilgou.begin: Wolves and Smashrooms are invading the Precipitous Hills, north of Dinotown. The chief of a neighboring village is looking for someone to kill a few of them in order to scare them off and restore natural order. Do you think you are strong enough to accept this mission?
kilgou.end: Well done, thanks to you the Hills are somewhat peaceful once again!

kilwlf.name: The Wolf Hunt
kilwlf.begin: Recently, farmers have had a lot of problems with groups of wolves attacking their goats. Can you stroll here and there and kill some of them to scare them away?
kilwlf.end: Well done, with that they shouldn't harm the goats for a while!

fflow.name: The Rose Bush in danger
fflow.begin: Madam Squyd's favorite rose bush is in a bad state following the heat wave. Can you go to the Fountain and get some Pure Water to bring to her?
fflow.end: The charming Madam Squyd sends her appreciation for your work. You deserve your reward!

pureWater.name: Pure Water
pureWater.description: You get some Pure Water to water the rose bush...

madameSeyche.name: Madam Squyd
madameSeyche.text: Ooh thanks little one! My rose bush will now regain its beautiful colors! Return to Grandpa Joe, he'll give you your reward...

kbook.name: The Recipe Book
kbook.begin: I've received another request from the pretty Madam Squyd. She wants to check a recipe in a book from the University. Can you take it to her?
kbook.end: Well done! Madam Squyd sent me a piece of grilled Korgon to thank me. It's delicious!

recipeBook.name: Recipe Book
recipeBook.description: You find the recipe book, \"100 Ways To Cook a Korgon\", written and illustrated by One-Eyed Gorak

madameSeyche.name: Madam Squyd
madameSeyche.text: Thank you so much little one! I'll be experimenting with different Korgon recipes, don't hesitate to come by from time to time and try them!

msg.name: The Stamps
msg.begin: I want to write a letter to someone who is close to my heart, but my stamps have been stolen by some thieving Smashrooms at the Fountain of Youth. If you kill them, I'll let you use my stamps, have we got a deal?
msg.end: Fantastic! I can send my letter now! Here you go, take these stamps, you really deserve them...

collectStamps.name: Pick up the Stamps
collectStamps.description: Well done! You've found the stamps, return them to Grandpa Joe as soon as possible!

lettre.name: The secret letter
lettre.begin: Uhm, this time it's for me, Grandpa Joe, that you will work for... I need your help to deliver an URGENT letter to someone special in Dinotown. It's urgent, it must be delivered as soon as possible!
lettre.end: What's this?! A reply?! Already! GREAT! She has accepted my invitation to dinner. I'm not too old to show her what a real man is made of!

madameSeyche.name: Madam Squyd
madameSeyche.text: Hello young Dinoz master, what have you brought me this time? What's that you've got there? A letter from Grandpa Joe? .... Bring him this in response quick!

kilglu.name: A strange monster
kilglu.begin: A Strange monster has recently appeared in the Dinotown Kingdom. Apparently it's very tough and can take a lot of damage during a battle. Can you kill one and bring it back to me so I can study it?
kilglu.end: Thanks, it's a fantastic specimen. Here's your reward!

kilgnt.name: The Giants
kilgnt.begin: I'm not sure if you've noticed but the Dinotown Kingdom has recently been invaded by huge Green Giants, and they don't just eat vegetables if you catch my drift!
