I need you to exterminate a dozen of them as quickly as possible! The order has come straight from the King, so we have to hurry!
kilgnt.end: Ooooooh! That was close! Thanks, you've really helped me out. I'll make sure to tell the King about your services while we play golf tomorrow.

kilcoq.name: Achievement of the month
kilcoq.begin: I've planned another Golf party with the King next month, and he wants to hear more about your exploits .... what do you think about killing some Giant Chickens for me this time? As per usual, you will be richly rewarded!
kilcoq.end: Ah! Fantastic! I'll embellish the story a bit to make it truly epic! This will surely please the King!

init1.name: The Trial
init1.begin: Yo... So, for the Strategy Guide, you have to translate it... in the Ashpouk ruins. You should be able to do it.

inspect.name: Inspect the guide
inspect.text: Hmmm ... do you understand anything? I don't. If only we had a dictionary it would be easy!

dictionary.title: Find the dictionary
dictionary.name: Ashpoukian Dictionary
dictionary.text: You find an old mould-covered dictionary in the library shelves. It's titled "Ashpouk-Dinozish, Little Lamousse Edition".

decipher.name: Decipher the guide
decipher.text: You start to decipher the mysterious Ashpouk inscriptions. After many hours of hard work, you finally understand everything: it seems as though it's an ancient recipe.

init1.end: Mmmm ... It looks like a recipe ... the famous legendary Archelion Merguez. Cool ... I'll cook some immediately. Congratulations on translating it, you really are skilled.

init2.name: The Archelionscarer
init2.begin: Hmmm, these Archelion merguez really pack a punch! Well now that I know you're competent, if you do me one more favor I'll give you my Strategy Guide. The Big All-Hot is an ideal environment for Archelions of all sizes. Wild, very dry and constantly erupting! But we have to stay away from them as long as we want to live, otherwise they'll eat us for supper. I want you to make me an Archelion scarecrow! It needs some Sharpened Claws.

claws.name: Pick up the claws
claws.text: You pick up two large baby Archelion claws. They need to be sharpened.

blacksmith.name: Smith
blacksmith.text: You need to sharpen some Archelion claws? You know that it's dangerous to walk around with those?! Even though it scares them slightly, it will attract ALL the other monsters!! Great job!! Some are already coming.

forgeGuard.name: Forges Guard
forgeGuard.text: You're responsible for this mess?! Don't expect any kindness! What's that?! The Shaman rascal sent you? He wants an Archelionscarer? They're easy to make, you just have to ... OH! Watch out! Others are coming!!
forgeGuard.text2: Well give me your claws so I can get rid of them! To scare the Archelion, apply this strong ointment each morning. I warn you, it has a very strong smell.

init2.end: Oh! I didn't know the claws did that! I'm so sorry! I hope that the Forges Guard didn't make too much of a fuss. Anyway, thanks for the ointment. I'll go and see if it works. Meanwhile, take my Strategy Guide as a thank you.

burn.name: Fire !
burn.begin: As you have probably noticed, this region is swarming with Flamelets. Even if their presence is necessary to complete the cosmic equilibrium, they have now over populated Dinoland and some need to be culled! We must hurry. Go to the Tunnel under the Branch passing alongside the crater. The place is swarming with them!

inspectAshes.name: Inspect the Pile of Ashes
inspectAshes.text: The ashes left by these Flamelets have a strange smell, like ... barbecue. This needs to be investigated.

artisan.name: Forges Artisan
artisan.text: Flamelets that smell like barbecue you say? Sorry, I've got no idea. But the smell is stronger in the west. Try looking in that direction.

sniff.name: Snif
sniff.text: Sniff, sniff ... Yes! The smell of barbecue here is the same as the pile of Flamelet ashes. There's no time to waste. You have to fight them!

search.name: Search around
search.text: It seems these flamelets came from the Merguez seller's barbecue. The Soft Shaman must be informed about this!

burn.end: Your actions have restored the region's equilibrium.....for now. It's a good start, but we have to do something about this barbecue business. Until then, here's a little reward for all your help.

barbec.name: The crazy barbecue
barbec.begin: It seems a certain merguez seller in the Ashpouk Ruins uses a special combustible which caused the influx of flamelets. Something must be done! However, we can't stop this poor merchant from doing his job, we will need to find a more subtle solution. Start by collecting some ingredients: a dry branch, a Dorogon scale and a piece of yellow basalt. Mix these ingredients up and grind them into a powder, then throw it onto the barbecue!

branch.name: Pick up a branch
branch.text: You find the first ingredient on the ground: a dried-up (or even charred) tree branch.

stealScale.name: Steal a Venerable Scale
stealScale.text: You approach the huge Dorogon, but it gives you a dark-and-icy look. Better find another way to get a scale!

searchBrokenScales.name: Search on the ground
searchBrokenScales.text: You search the lair, but you only find broken scales.

inspectEntrance.name: Inspect the Lair Entrance
inspectEntrance.text: Just outside the Venerable's lair, you see a beautiful and shiny scale tucked away under a pile of rocks. That solves your problem nicely.

basalt.name: Search for basalt
basalt.text: You spend hours searching for a piece of yellow basalt. You finally find one on the slopes.

grind.name: Grind the ingredients into powder
grind.text: You use your hammer to grind the ingredients into a fine powder. That'll do!

mix.name: Use the mix
mix.text: As soon as you throw the mix into the flames, streaks of multicoloured lightning shoot out from every direction and crackle all around the barbecue. But as quickly as they appeared, the streaks of lightning disappear and the barbecue returns to normal. Only the sound of faint crackles and pops reminds you that anything happened.

barbec.end: Well done! The new mix should reduce the effects of the magic barbecue without altering the taste of the delicious Merguez. Take this tamed little Flamelet as a reward.

joke.name: Quarrel
joke.begin: For many years, University Professor Eugene and I have had an on-going quarrel. In fact, we never agree on a subject, no matter what the subject is! Help me play a trick on this old curmydgeon. First of all I want you to find something with a pungent smell. I think Frish Port will be a good place to look...

fish.name: Take some leftover fish
fish.text: You pick up the worst-smelling fish you can find, including a horrible-smelling Fetid-Fish!

trap.name: Prank Professor
trap.text: You place the foul-smelling fish leftovers in the drawers of the Professor Eugene's desk. Ha ha!

joke.end: Yes! That's perfect! I never thought you would hide a Fetid-Fish in his office. How cunning!

defend.name: Defense of the Forges!
defend.begin: I saw swarms of monsters moving towards the mountains this morning. It looked like they were heading for the forges of the Big All-Hot. Go and protect them!

forgeGuard.name: Forges Guard
forgeGuard.text: Attention soldier! We have to hold on! Hold your positions! Monsters incoming!
forgeGuard.text2: Thanks for your help soldier! I've seen many monsters hiding at the Slopes, we must pursue and kill them this time!
forgeGuard.text3: Good job soldier! Thanks to your heroic efforts victory is ours. Give this recommendation letter to the Soft Shaman, he'll know how to reward you.

scout.name: Forges Scout
scout.text: They're hiding in the caverns at the edge of the Basalt Slopes sir. You'll have to flush them out one by one!

banner.name: Pick up their banner
banner.text: You find the war banner worn by the monsters chief! This should please the Forges Guard...

defend.end: The letter is very complementary about you. It seems you more than deserve your reward! As you found the Monsters' War Banner, I've added a little something as a bonus.

shipmt.name: The missing package
shipmt.begin: Some time ago, I ordered a new powder reserve for my rituals from Grandpa Joe, but my package never arrived! Maybe this is because of the recent attack on the Forges, it must be lost somewhere. The package is extremely important, can you find it for me? It's very urgent!

courier.name: Dinotown Courier
courier.text: Help!! I had to deliver an important package to the top of the volcano, but a group of aggressive goblins attacked me! They've stolen my package and I don't know what to do. I'll be fired unless I get the package back!
courier.text2: Thank you so much, you've saved my life! Hey! I think that my package is over there!
courier.text3: I saw loads of goblins running towards the north. Go and find them, then meet up with me again at the Lavapit once you have found the contents!
courier.text4: Ah you've found the contents of my package! Great! I don't know how to thank you. I will speak highly of you to the Soft Shaman!

package.name: Pick up the package
package.text: You find the package near a goblin. Unfortunately it's empty! You have to find out what happened to it's contents.

noises.name: Suspect Noises...
noises.text: You hear noises coming from the shadows of the cavern. It must be the goblins you are searching for!

goods.name: Pick up the goods
goods.text: You pick up some gourds of multicoloured powders, these must be the items that the Soft Shaman ordered from Grandpa Joe.

shipmt.end: My courier just delivered my order. He explained that he wouldn't have been able to deliver the package without your help! Take this potion and a little reward as a token of my gratitude!

sales.name: (not) fair trade
sales.begin: I sell little trinkets from time to time at the Dinotown market to make a little money. Unfortunately I'm really busy at the moment, do you think that you could go there for me and sell some souvenirs? I'll give you a nice percentage of the profits! You'll see, my souvenirs sell very well.

collect.name: Take the trinkets
collect.text: You get some old-looking objects from the ruins to flog as souvenirs at Dinotown market.

sell.name: Dinotown Market
sell.text: You spend the next hour selling pieces of rubble and broken combat gear as souvenirs to the highest bidder. Everyone is bidding on the items! The Shaman was right, it seems you'll be able to sell all your stock without any difficulty at all.

ritual.name: Ridiculous ritual
ritual.begin: The Shamanic Congregation, where I learned my trade, wants me to perform a ritual each year as a way of paying them back for all my training. Of course, I have better things to do than this stupid ritual! Can you take care of this for me? The instructions are in my mailbox.

instructions.name: Take the instructions
instructions.text: You take the letter from the Congregation. The instructions state that you must begin the ritual by killing a Goblin in a single combat...

read.name: Follow the next instruction
read.text: The letter says that you must chant: "SHAMANA MANA!"

shamana.name: Chant Shamana Mana...
shamana.text: SHAMANA MANA! ... Ok, well, let's go on to the next instruction.

donga.name: Chant Donga Donga...
donga.text: DONGA! DONGAAA! ... All that's left now is to chant on the western face of the volcano.

crater.name: Throw a Stone in the Crater
crater.text: You throw a stone into the huge crater to complete the Ridiculous Ritual.

ritual.end: Judging by the forelorn look on your face, you probably understand why I had no desire to do this stupid ritual. Anyway, thanks for the favour, here's something to make up for your trouble.

hiero.name: Hieroglyphs
hiero.begin: I've heard that there are some hieroglyphics in the caverns to the west, en route to Grumhel Jungle. These hieroglyphics are very important for my mystical research! Go and copy them out for me. Be careful! To enter the caverns you will need to find something that will help you find your way back in the darkness!

copy.name: Copy out the Hieroglyphics
copy.text: You copy out the Hieroglyphics using the scroll given to you by the Shaman.

hiero.end: Hmmm ... very interesting ... Hmmm ... Here's something that should gobsmack that old grumpy clown from the University! Thanks for your help!

pigeon.name: Homing pigeon
pigeon.begin: The recent discoveries in the caverns have provided me with an unexpected occasion to prove my theories to Professor Eugene! Imagine that, some ancient handwriting that talks of current events! We can't waste any time! Take this letter to him!

eugene.name: Talk to Professor Eugene
eugene.text: I see that this crazy magician has found something else to bother me with! Hmm ... Hmm ... OH! Oh my god! It can't be! I have to be certain before I can comment any further. Show this letter to my dear friend Doctor Yolande on Waïkiki Island immediately!

yolande.name: Doctor Yolande
yolande.text: Wow! This came from the caverns of Deep Gorges you say? It's incredible! You must show this to Mister Shovel, The Brutforce Archeologist.

findPelletee.name: Find the Archeologist
findPelletee.text: Archeologist Shovel doesn't seem to be here. Apparently he is working on a construction site in the Deep Gorges.

pelletee.name: Archeologist Shovel
pelletee.text: Oh ... That's funny, this looks a lot like the notes I left on the cavern walls. What's that you say? The Shaman thought it was ancient texts?! Of course not! I wrote those, they're my personal notes.

pigeon.end: Aargh! I was sure that we had stumbled upon a historical discovery! Don't worry ... thanks for your help in any case. Here, take this as a reward.

rodriz.name: The Amnesiac Rice
rodriz.begin: I need some Amnesiac Rice to recharge my magic cape. I've been told that it grows in the Sticky Swamp of the Atlanteid Islands. Can you bring me enough Rice to recharge my cape so I can become invisible again? Hurry up, it's really important!

search.name: Search for Rice
search.text: After searching the Swamp for several hours, you finally find an area full of Amnesiac Rice, a rare variety of Rice with amazing properties! The only problem is that hundreds of Pirhanoz are protecting the entrance. You'll have find a way past them!

pick.name: Gather the Rice
pick.text: Congratulations! You've found some Amnesiac Rice!

rodriz.end: To be honest, I didn't need the Amnesiac Rice, sorry! I only needed a little bit of lightning energy to recharge my cape ... here, take this as a reward. You can keep the rice too, I don't need it anymore.

rodlif.name: The Dark Dinoz
rodlif.begin: Three Dark Dinoz from Caushemesh are waiting for you at the Mutant Falls. Go and defeat them and then return to receive your reward ... take my advice, don't try to defeat them alone, your Dinoz could die!
rodlif.end: Not bad for a weak Dinoz from Dinotown ... here take this!

kilpir.name: The Birthday Present
kilpir.begin: It's Sophie from Waikiki Island's birthday soon. Her favorite meal is made from Pirhanoz found in the Sticky Swamp. Can you bring her a few Pirhanoz for me?

sophie.name: Sophie
sophie.text: Oh! You're so kind! Thank you for bringing me these delicious Piranhoz for my birthday! Give Mister Bao a kiss from me!

kilpir.end: I like giving presents ... here, take this as a reward.

troc.name: The Barter of the Atlanteid Islands
troc.begin: Bartering is common in the Islands. You can exchange goods for an item you desire. I'd like to exchange a banana for a coat rack. Do you think you can do that for me?

merchant.name: A Merchant
merchant.text: This banana looks delicious! I'll give you my kite in exchange!

lover.name: A Lover
lover.text: Pfff ... I'm on my way to the Fountain of Youth, if you would like, I'll give you this brand new engagement ring in exchange for your kite.

jeweler.name: A jeweller
jeweler.text: What! I can't believe it! This ring is part of an ancient royal collection! I'll give you the most valuable thing I own in exchange for the ring, my villa on Totem Island! Take the keys, you can't refuse!

tourist.name: A Stuck Tourist
tourist.text: I am sick of this sss...swamp!!!!! This is the third time our Motor-Home has got stuck in the mud. What a stupid idea to go on vacation IN A SWAMP! What? A villa on Totem Island? Of course I'll exchange it for my Motor-Home!

artist.name: An Enthusiastic Artist
artist.text: Fantastic! I'm so happy! Look at these faces! It's a work of art! What? how can it be trashy? You don't even understand art! My work is easily worth the same as a motor-home. I'll exchange with you!

oldLady.name: An Old Woman
oldLady.text: I heard you're looking for a coat rack. I'll trade it for whatever you have ... wait, what is that? "Faces"? It looks like nothing. . . it can't be worth much. Besides, I've never heard of "Picassi". Don't worry, you can still have the coat rack in exchange.

troc.end: You found my coat rack? I hope this little journey has shown you that most valuable treasures have to be earned!

kilksk.name: The Kazkadine Hunt
kilksk.begin: I just received an emergency call from the Underwater Dome. The Atalants are extremely worried about the number of invading Kazkadines. Can you take your Dinoz there to clean it up? Make sure you don't get electrocuted.
kilksk.end: Well Done! You successfully sealed the Kazkadine leak in the Underwater Dome!

kilang.name: Eeloz with vinegar
kilang.begin: Do you know the traditional dish: Eeloz with vinegar? It's delicious! Can you get some fresh Eeloz and vinegar and take them to my friend at Frish Port? It's a present!

wineMerchant.name: Wine Merchant
wineMerchant.text: Umm? You're here on behalf of Mr Bao, looking for vinegar? Here, I have this old Chateau BrutForce which is perfect for cooking with.

fisher.name: Fisherman
fisher.text: Are you looking for Mr Bao's friend? I think he went to visit Miss Squyd in Dinotown.

madameSeyche.name: Madam Squyd
madameSeyche.text: Ooooh the cute little Dinoz!!! What? You're looking for Mr Bao's friend? He went to see old Grandpa Joe, they had important things to talk about!

adamNature.name: Adam Nature
adamNature.text: Yum! Eeloz with vinegar!! I love this dish! Sorry I didn't wait for you at Frish Port. I'll tell Bob to give you a reward!

kilang.end: You're walking around during a mission? Adam told me everything. Here, take this, it's for you.

bigpch.name: The Great Hunt
bigpch.begin: I'm a bit embarrassed. I promised the Underwater Dome Archsage that I would exterminate 150 Atlanteid Island monsters in ten days. Unfortunately I've broken my arm and can't really move. Can you kill thirty monsters for me? I'll take care of the others!
bigpch.end: Fantastic! I can now exterminate the others on my own using my feet, thanks for your help.

rally1.name: The Sardine Rally
rally1.begin: Take part in the Sardine Rally! Go to Frish Port as fast as possible!

step.name: Rally Checkpoint
step.description: You pass the finish line, now return to Mr Bao Bob!

rally1.end: Congratulations for finishing the Rally. Here's your prize.

rally2.name: The Fish Rally
rally2.begin: Take part in the Fishes Rally! Go to Frish Port as quickly as possible!

step.name: Rally Checkpoint
step.description: You pass the first Rally checkpoint, now you have to go to the University!
step.description2: You pass the second checkpoint, now return to Mr Bao Bob!

rally2.end: Congratulations for finishing the Rally. Here's your prize.

rally3.name: The Shark Rally
rally3.begin: Take part in the Sharks Rally! Go to the Coral Mines as quickly as possible!

step.name: Rally Checkpoint
step.description: You pass the first Rally checkpoint, now you have to go to BrutForce!
step.description2: You pass the second Rally checkpoint, now you have to go to the Basalt Slopes!
step.description3: You pass the third checkpoint, now return to Mr Bao Bob!

rally3.end: Congratulations for finishing the Rally. Here's your prize.

rally4.name: The Whale Rally
rally4.begin: Take part in the Whales Rally! Go to Lavapit and return as quickly as possible!

step.name: Rally Checkpoint
step.description: You pass the Rally checkpoint, now return to Mr Bao Bob as soon as possible!

rally4.end: Congratulations for finishing the Rally. Here's your prize.

tour.name: The Dinoland Tour
tour.begin: The DinoLand Tour is the most famous race in all of DinoLand! Race round Dinoland in less than ten days! The first checkpoint is on Waikiki Island.

step.name: Tour Checkpoint
step.description: Congratulations for passing the first checkpoint of the Dinoland Tour. The next checkpoint is located in BrutForce. Good luck!
step.description2: Congratulations for passing the second checkpoint of the Dinoland Tour. The next checkpoint is in the Precipitous Hills. Good luck up there!
step.description3: Congratulations for passing the third checkpoint of the Dinoland Tour. The next checkpoint is in Lavapit. Good luck climbing the Big All-Hot!
step.description4: Congratulations for passing the fourth checkpoint of the Dinoland Tour. The next checkpoint is in the Korgons' Camp in Grumhel Forest. Avoid being slowed down by the monsters!
step.description5: Congratulations for passing the fifth checkpoint of the Dinoland Tour. The next checkpoint is in Forest Threshold! Be careful! don't get lost on the Dark Path....
step.description6: Congratulations for passing the sixth checkpoint of the Dinoland Tour! Now return to Bao Bob to win the Tour!

tour.end: Bravo! That was a great performance. Here, take this, it's a reward for your success!

kswim.name: Like a Korgon in Water
kswim.begin: The Grumhel Jungle is a fascinating place! Just take a look at the Korgons. They've perfectly adapted to their environment! Did you know that they make their own fins which they use to cross the Jumin River? No? I'll give you this pair if you agree to bring me some much-needed supplies...
kswim.end: Perfect! I've got everything I need! Here, take these Korgon fins as promised!

supplies.name: Check supply list
supplies.description: Dian Korgsey's list shows that she really needs some tools. You can find them at the forges of the Big All-Hot.

tools.name: Pick up the tools
tools.description: You pick up a pouch of tools. "Branches from the Ashpouk Ruins" are also on the list.

wood.name: Cut down branches
wood.description: You pick up a few charred branches. Last on the list is "a charm".

grigri.name: Ask the Shaman for a charm
grigri.description: The Shaman grins and gives you one of his lucky charms. Thanks!

rivals.name: Korgons of the North, Korgons of the South
rivals.begin: The Korgons found in this part of Grumhel Jungle are quite friendly. Southern Korgons from the Sinister Path are far less friendly. If you bring me proof of victory against the Southern Korgons, the Northern Korgons will like us a lot more!
rivals.end: Ah! Good idea, Korgon Claws! the Northern Korgons seem to like it ... here, take this for your trouble.

trophy.name: Find a trophy
trophy.description: You pick up a few Korgon claws to use as a trophy for the Northern Korgons...

kfood.name: Wood Steak
kfood.begin: The Ashy Fikoia is a very rare tree that grows somewhere in Grumhel Forest, the Korgons love it! I don't know where to find it, but I'll pay you well if you bring me some branches!
kfood.end: The Korgons will love that, thanks a lot!

tree.name: Strange Tree
tree.description: You notice an odd-looking tree with grey leaves which smells like stale tobacco ... this must be The Ashy Fikoia! But wait! while you're preparing to take a few branches, you hear noises coming from the undergrowth...

branches.name: Cut Down A Few Branches
branches.description: Better to not stay here for too long: you cut down a few branches and quickly move away from the tree.

poison.name: Korgon Rivalries
poison.begin: The Ashy Fikoia you found will quickly become a strategic point for the Southern Korgons ... We have to react quickly! We will "booby-trap" some of the trees' branches in order to stop them from eating it ... we'll be the only ones who know which branches are dangerous ... ha ha!
poison.end: Thanks for all your help, we won't forget it!

sap.name: Pick Up The Sap
sap.description: You pick up some Oozing Mordicus, tree sap with a disgusting taste. This will be ideal for our trap.

trap.name: Entrap The Fikoia
trap.description: >Noooo! The Fikoia has disappeared! The Southern Korgons must have got here before us!

ambush.name: Ambush
ambush.description: While travelling in the Wild Jungle, a group of Korgons ambushes you! You've got to get rid of them to continue...

track.name: Tracks On The Ground
track.description: The large tracks on the ground indicate that something very heavy has passed this way from Jumin River ... the tracks lead towards the south.
track.description2: The tracks end here ... judging by the growls coming from the bushes, someone or something has been waiting for you to arrive!

fikoia.name: Ashy Fikoia
fikoia.description: The Ashy Fikoia is hidden under a pile of banana tree leaves. You'll have to drag it back to camp...

dian.name: Dian Korgsey
dian.text: Here you are! It's a shame that they cut down The Ashy Fikoia ... it seems like the work of the Southern Korgons, without doubt ... well, we can't travel up river with it. Hide it here, it'll be safe enough. We'll meet up again at the camp.

hideFikoia.name: Hide The Fikoia
hideFikoia.description: You hide the tree under some banana tree leaves.

seqact.name: Sinister Path
seqact.begin: To enter the jungle, you must take the Sinister Path ... it's a dangerous road that leads north. Can you make sure it's safe?
seqact.end: I can't hear any more growling coming from the path ... that's a good sign, isn't it?

toxic.name: Allergies
toxic.begin: I'm allergic to certain plants that are found in the jungle ... but I don't know which ones! Can you gather some suspicious-looking plants for me so I can carry out some tests?
toxic.end: These are perfect! ... I'll try to find out which one causes my allergies ... Take this as a thank you.

figonicia.name: Furuncle Figonicia
figonicia.text: You pick a blistered and sticky flower...

purulente.name: Black Purulent
purulente.text: The Purulent emits a small cloud of suspicious, foul-smelling pollen....mmmm....very strange, better pick this one.

visqueuse.name: Mud Viscous
visqueuse.text: You find a big greenish water lily lying in a puddle of stagnant water.

map.name: Cartography
map.begin: A good map always helps. The only problem is there's no map available for the Grumhel Jungle! Can you head north and take some notes for me? The hills are located to the east, they'll provide you with the perfect viewpoint!
map.end: It's not bad at all! I'll study this map in order to prepare my extreme expedition.

draw.name: Draw a Map
draw.text: You set up on an old tree stump to start drawing the map of the surrounding area ... Suddenly, a hideous Tawny-Bat comes out of nowhere and grabs your notepad with its jaws! It flies away immediately and sits on a high branch...

catch.name: Catch the Tawny-Bat
catch.text: You are sure you hear the bat giggling on it's perch ... you shake a branch to make the Bat fall, but it flies away and escapes into the jungle!

bat.name: Tawny-Bat
bat.text: The tawny-bat finally settles on the top of a huge tree! It calmly stares down at you.

stone.name: Throw a Stone
stone.text: You've hit the bull's eye! The Tawny-Bat cries and your notepad falls to the bottom of the tree. Irritated, the bat crawls to your feet and glares at you...

notebook.name: Pick Up the Note Pad
notebook.text: You've finally got your notepad back!

finish.name: Draw the Map
finish.text: You finish drawing the map, making sure to keep your guard up this time!

hucure.name: Remedy
hucure.begin: Vat's is nice from you... I vink the Bonks from mutant valls can help me... Take the blants you brought me and go to see them on my vehalf ...Sniff...
hucure.end: Glou glou! Fanks... Jwust hopfe it wiwll work... Take fis pofion aws aw szign of gratifuwde.

plants.name: Take the Plants
plants.text: You take Nicolas' toxic plants. It seems that he tried to infuse them...

monk.name: Monk Doctor
monk.text: You gave him a Furuncle Figonicia? A Black Purulent?! A Mud Viscous!! Woaw ... We have to hurry! Bring me some coral powder immediately!
monk.text2: Bring me some Korgon fangs from the Sinister Path and some Tawny-Bat wings from the north.
monk.text3: Perfect! I can cook a delicious meal. Hmmm, sorry? Ahh! That's right you came for a remedy didn't you. Worry not, I have a crate full of remedy, take what you need. Shall I keep some soup for you?

coral.name: Coral Piece
coral.text: You pick up a piece of broken coral: that should do.

backCoral.title: Take coral back to the monk

backIngredients.title: Take the Ingredients back to the Falls

fangs.name: Pick up the Fangs
fangs.text: You pick up some Korgon fangs.

wings.name: Pick up the Wings
wings.text: You pick up a nice pair of Tawny-Bat wings...

antidote.name: Remedy Crates
antidote.text: You take with you a few antidote vials for Nicolas Mulot, we never know...

bckpck.name: Survival Kit
bckpck.begin: Before starting my long and dangerous journey, there's one more thing I need, a good backpack. I lost mine when I was travelling through the Mutant Falls ... Can you find it for me?
bckpck.end: You won't believe this, I just received a spare backpack! I ordered it in anticipation of my journey ... No problem, I have a great idea! I'll take back my old backpack and give you the new one! It's a deal?

extremeFisher.name: Extreme Fisherman
extremeFisher.text: A bag pack y'say? Nope I don't remember fishing dat! Ya should mayb'see if it was carried away toward the swamp by the current?

seaweedCollector.name: Seaweed Harvester
seaweedCollector.text: Ah, I remember!! It was a very nice backpack, it was stuck in a bog! I gave it to one of my cousins so that he could carry his stones, it's really practical! Gosh!

miners.name: Interrogate the Miners
miners.text: You ask the miners some questions, they point to another miner...

restingMiner.name: Miner taking a break
restingMiner.text: Yup. I know what you're talking about. But I don't have it anymore. (He spits on the ground) Yup. I only had it for a couple of days. I sent it to my cousin in Frish Port. I thought he could use it as a good fishing net. (He spits again)

busyFisher.name: Busy Fisherman
busyFisher.text: The bag? I still have it! But it's in terrible condition! I can fix it for you if you would like ... but I need a bobbin of thread and sewing needles. You can buy these items in Dinotown I think.
busyFisher.text2: Ah, you brought exactly what I need to patch up your bag. (One hour later..........) Done!

sewingMaterial.name: Find a Bobbin
sewingMaterial.text: You check all the Dinotown shops to find the Sewing Material. You finally find a sewing shop...

seamstress.name: Dressmaker
seamstress.text: Good day to you Dinoz Master, welcome to my shop! Needle and thread? Yes I have some, but they're not cheap ... if I agree to give it to you, will you do me a favour? I live near the fountain and every evening my house is attacked by monstrous Giant Chickens! If you help me I'll give you the material for free.
seamstress.text2: Thank you so much for all your help! Here's the material as I promised...

unmute.name: The Forest Warden
unmute.begin: The scroll which has fallen on your head includes the following message: &&|« Find 1 measure of fresh free-flowing water, 1 measure of stagnant water, 1 measure of purified water and lastly 1 measure of boiling water. » You've barely finished reading the message before an empty small gourd falls from the tree and hits you on the head! Plunk!
unmute.end: The old tree bows down to you ... he slowly shakes his leaves, some beautiful fruits then fall at your feet.

juminWater.name: Jumin River Water
juminWater.description: You fill the empty gourd with a small amount of Jumin River water. You've found running water!

swampWater.name: Cloudy Water
swampWater.description: You add a small amount of Sticky Swamp water to the half empty gourd. It smells very bad...

pureWater.name: Refreshing Water
pureWater.description: You add a small amount of Fountain clear water to the gourd and refresh yourself at the same time.

boilingWater.name: Boiling Water
boilingWater.description: You fill the gourd with a small amount of boiling water from the Gorges. It's hot!

pourGourd.name: Pour the gourd on the roots
pourGourd.description: The old tree's leaves suddenly shake in every direction and a soothing light fills the jungle all around you...

orchid.name: Greens Thumb
orchid.begin: A scroll dangles down from a branch. It reads: &&|« Go water the Orchid Child at the Edge of the Jungle ».| Something in the canopy throws you an empty gourd. Plunk!
orchid.end: You place the gourd at the bottom of the tree. A big fruit drops from the upper branches and falls close to you with a thud.

takeWater.name: Take Water
takeWater.description: You fill the gourd with Jumin River water.

waterOrchid.name: Water The Orchid
waterOrchid.description: You pour the contents of the gourd onto a magnificent flower, "The Orchid Child". Immediately, it lights up like a thousand fires and some beautiful dew drops form on it's graceful leaves.

talkingOrchid.name: Speaking To Orchid Child
talkingOrchid.text: What?! What are you looking at? You've never seen an Orchid blooming before?! You have nothing else to do? Go away, leave me alone!!

licens.name: Permission to cut
licens.begin: You see a scroll is attached to a root. It reads: &&|« Korgons and Bramble Eaters from the south are exceeding the wood cutting quota that I set in the Grumhel Jungle. Go and make sure they stick to the quota. »
licens.end: Many fruits fall from the tree...

king.name: The King of the Jungle
king.begin: A message has been written on a small piece of cloth hooked on a branch: &&|« A few years ago we created a story about a King of the Jungle in order to keep tourists away. Go to the Haunted Hills and pretend to be the King of the Jungle by calling out.... »
king.end: A fruit falls near you. While you are bending over to pick it up, a big purse full of gold falls out of nowhere and hits you on the head! Plunk!

cry.name: The King of the Jungle's Call
cry.description: Your call is too weak! it wouldn't even scare a Korgon ... You need a better one!

talkingOrchid.name: Speaking Orchid Child
talkingOrchid.text: Still here are we stupid? Why are you looking at me like that, have you got a problem?

pickOrchid.name: Pick the Orchid
pickOrchid.description: Without paying attention, you uproot the orchid and take it with you. It shouts insults at you whilst using all it's strength to try and break free.

plantOrchid.name: Plant the Orchid
plantOrchid.description: You quickly replant the Orchid Child. While you are leaving, you can still can hear it screaming at you ... that should be enough to scare the tourists off!

wishes.name: Make your wishes
wishes.begin: You read a message inscribed on a branch: &&|« Legend says that the South Falls have magic properties ... Go and throw a coin into the Mutant Falls. Make a wish that the population of Korgons and Bramble Eaters in the jungle will decrease.»| A copper coin rolls along a branch and hits your foot.
wishes.end: Many fruits fall from the tree...

throwCoin.name: Throw a coin
throwCoin.description: You throw a coin into the Falls and wait a few minutes ... nothing happens so you decide to grant the wish yourself.

newplt.name: A Jack For The Forest
newplt.begin: A long piece of cloth is wrapped around the old tree, it reads: &&|« Our efforts to develop the forest near the Big All-Hot have recently been compromised by a huge rockfall near the Ashpouk Ruins. Take this jack and remove the plants and rocks. »| A heavy iron jack suddenly falls on the ground next to you.
newplt.end: Two big fruits fall from the trees into a bush near you...

volunteer.name: «Green Peace» Volunteer
volunteer.text: Hello! Are you here to help me clear the rockfall? I have a big problem at the moment ... Monsters always disturb me whilst I'm working ... Can you help me?
volunteer.text2: No time to waste, keep clearing!
volunteer.text3: I will stay here to water the surviving plants. Report back to the Forest Warden for me.

liftRocks.name: Lift up the rocks
liftRocks.description: You pick up your jack and start to clear the rockfall ... while you are working, you hear a disturbing growl behind you...
liftRocks.description2: Even using the jack, it still takes you hours to clear the rockfall. At the end you manage to free the trees and plants that were buried under the rocks.

gshop.name: Monkey Money
gshop.begin: A wooden sign and a little white iron bucket are hanging on a branch: &&|« Drop some gold into the bucket to get your daily ration. »
gshop.end: The text on the wooden sign has changed! It now reads: « Keep the blossoming branch as a proof of our gratitude. »

examineBucket.name: Inspect the bucket
examineBucket.description: You find a little branch in the bucket...

skul1.name: Prologue
skul1.begin: Years ago when we were living together, Moulder was affected by my curse. He forgot me instantly. It's not my fault, I have no way of controlling the curse. After he forgot me, Moulder moved far, far away, the ruffian! I'm sure he's still in contact with his nephew Little Joe. Go and see him, make sure to keep me informed!

papyJoe.name: Grandpa Little Joe
papyJoe.text: Uncle Moulder? It's been a long time since I've heard from him. If you want to know more, bring me three Goblin Merguez from the Big All-Hot!
papyJoe.text2: Thanks! (munch, munch) all I know is that Uncle Moulder loved his wife. He engraved a message for her on the Fountain of Youth.

message.name: Read the Message
message.description: On one of the engravings on the Fountain of Youth, you read the following message: "I'll be waiting for you at the place we first met"

skul1.end: Thanks. This information is priceless. My dear Moulder can't be far away, we'll be together again soon!

skul2.name: On Moulder's Trail
skul2.begin: "I'll be waiting for you at the place we first met" Oh oh oh oh! My Moulder is so romantic! I hope he's still waiting there for me! Go quickly to the magnificient place filled with the odour of waterillies where we first met and bring me back my love!

stuckTourist.name: A Stuck Tourist
stuckTourist.text: I'm sick of this sh... Swamp!!!!! It's the third time our Motor-Home has got stuck here, what a dumb idea to come on VACATION IN A SWAMP!!! What? Have I seen someone called Moulder? Ah! Yes, he was going to an Anonymous Eeloz Association meeting! Be careful is you decide to go too, they can be very touchy...

aaa.name: A.E.A. Assembly
aaa.begin: As you are approaching, some Eeloz notice your Dinoz and attack!
aaa.win: After defeating the Eeloz, you notice some steep tracks heading towards the west...

fisherman.name: Fisherman
fisherman.text: This is a good place to fish. Fish come here to see the levitating monks... A guy named Moulder? I know him well: He went to Piranhoz Bay to go fishing. Take care man, those guys bite.
fisherman.text2: Moulder? He left, he told me he was going back to wait for his wife at the Swamp. Poor guy, he hasn't seen her in years. If I were him I'd be happy about that! Ha Ha!

piranhozBay.name: Piranhoz Bay
piranhozBay.begin: After entering the bay, many Piranhoz rush to bite you. Who would want to fish here???
piranhozBay.win: Once you've defeated the Piranhoz, you take a look around. If Moulder was fishing here, he's certainly not here anymore.

swampSign.name: Sign
swampSign.description: A sign seems to have been placed near a bed of waterlilies. The sign reads: "I'm sick of these mosquitos, meet me where I declared my love for you. Moulder x."

skul2.end: Oh! My dear Moulder! I feel closer to you than ever!

skul3.name: Miss Bao
skul3.begin: Oh no! I've just realised something that could be a problem. Even if I find Moulder, he'll forget meeting me again and will go somewhere else to wait for me. You must find a solution before I see Moulder. Go and see Miss Bao, she should have a solution!

baoBob.name: Miss Bao???
baoBob.text: What??? Miss Bao?? No ... don't you know who I am? .......... If you're looking for my sister, she's with the grandson of the ArchDorogon: "The Venerable" as he likes to be called nowadays. If his father finds out that he likes to be called that, there'll be trouble.

baoBabe.name: Miss Bao
baoBabe.text: What??? Miss Bao?? It's been years since anybody has called me that. Please call me by my first name young man, Babe.

baoBabe2.name: Bao Babe
baoBabe2.text: If you want my advice, I'm afraid you're going to have to wait for a while. I need to finish my game of Draughts with the ArchDorogon's grandson. His grandfather made me promise to visit his grandson from time to time to keep him company. Why don't you go and hunt some goblins whilst you wait?
baoBabe2.text2: Finished! I beat him hands down. Hi hi hi! I love to make him lose his temper, he's so cute when his nostrils flare and start to blow vapour! You said you needed some advice?
baoBabe2.text3: Right. The solution to this kind of problem is really simple: Moulder must keep a piece of Skully with him at all times so that he never forgets her. See you later young man!

skul3.end: Oh! Here's a nice solution for my problem! Here, take this, now you'll never forget the way to the cemetary, nor your dear Skully!

skul4.name: The Annoying Tourists
skul4.begin: "Meet me where I declared my love for you" Oh oh oh oh! My dear Moulder has a heart of gold! I'll never forget the place where he took us, while we were still young. Nor the moment he gave me a well grilled merguez and asked me if I would marry him!

merguezSeller.name: Merguez Seller
merguezSeller.text: A strange customer? Yeah, there was a thin-looking guy who was here a while ago, he was letting out a lot of sighs. I remember he was on his way to the ruins. Be careful! There are some strange tourists around.
merguezSeller.text2: You saved Jean-Claude? Ah!! Thanks a lot. Those steppes bandits ruined the Ruins' tourist industry. I don't know how to thank you! Moulder? He promised to come back if I prepared him some Napalm shrimps, but I don't know the recipe.

visitRuins.name: Visit the Ruins
visitRuins.begin: May the Bambooz power be with me! Come on!
visitRuins.win: Before collapsing, Barababor whispers the following words: "We've captured your friend: he will be taken to our native steppes by boat, where he will be sold into slavery!"

suspiciousBoat.name: Search for the strange boat
suspiciousBoat.description: After searching for a while, you finally find a strange-looking boat that matches your description.

enterBoat.name: Board the Boat
enterBoat.begin: May the Bambooz power be with me! I will avenge my brother!!!
enterBoat.win: After defeating the bandits, you free a hostage who was tied-up in the boat...

freedMan.name: Freed Man
freedMan.text: Thhh Thhaannkksss!! I hahahave hahad fefefear you know! Moulder?? Nono, my nananame is Jean-Claude. I am a friefriend of the mermerguez seller! Ththanks anayway fofor your help!

skul4.end: I can feel Moulder coming closer, thanks a lot for your help my young friend!

skul5.name: Napalm Shrimp
skul5.begin: "Napalm Shrimp"? Oh! That brings back sweet memories, what a delicious dish! You'll have to bring me specific ingredients so that I can properly prepare it.

skully.text: Well, first of all, I need some shrimp. You can find some at the Underwater Dome Market! Go quickly!
skully.text2: Oh oh oh! Ma-gni-fi-cient! These shrimp are so fresh! Now that we've got some shrimp, we need to gather the next ingredient. Some Napalm. To make it, we need some good quality lava.
skully.text3: Oh! Superb Napalm! But the recipe can't be completed without adding a vitally important ingredient. Some fatty Korgon's hair! You can often find some near the Big All-Hot, but make sure you don't end up stealing someone's dinner or else you'll live to regret it!
skully.text4: Stir stir! Here we are! A magnificient dish of Napalm Shrimp!

shrimpMerchant.name: Shrimp Merchant
shrimpMerchant.text: I'm sorry but following recent fraudulent transactions, I no longer accept gold coins as payment for my shrimp. You'll have to bring me 3 Treasury Notes...
shrimpMerchant.text2: Thanks, here are your shrimp! Bon appetit!

shamanMou.text: Some Napalm? Mmmm ... you'll need to make a mixture of half-lava, half-flamelets. We have loads of lava here, so all you need to get are 5 boxes of Flamelets in order to prepare the mixture.
shamanMou.text2: Glou glou! Here you are, some low density Napalm is ready and waiting for you.

korgonSearch.name: Search for a Korgon
korgonSearch.win: You've captured a fatty Korgon. Let's hope it wasn't someone else's dinner!

skul5.end: Thanks for your help! I can't wait to see my dear Moulder again!

skuend.name: The Reunion
skuend.begin: Your mission has reached it's conclusion. Take the Napalm Shrimp to my dear Moulder. He will recognise my cooking and will come back to me immediately! Oh oh oh! I can't wait for him to return!
skuend.merguezSeller: Ooooohh!! So these are the famous Napalm Shrimp?!? Let's see ... mmmm ... it's missing a bit of fat but it's still incredibly succulent. Without a doubt Moulder sill arrive soon. Ahhhh! Look who's coming!
skuend.end: Ooooooooooooooohhh! He's back, he's back! My dear Moulder is back!!! Thank you so much for all your help young man!!

mmex1.name: The Black Briefcase
mmex1.begin: Last night a ship delivered a Black Briefcase for me at Frish Port. Can you go and pick it up for me? Make sure you don't open it!

take.name: Take the Black Briefcase
take.text: You've been given the Black Briefcase from a man dressed in a long trench coat. This mission seems too easy!

madameX.name: Miss X
madameX.text: That's strange ... the briefcase ... IT WAS BOOBY-TRAPPED!

trap.name: Trap!
trap.begin: A Gluon has been put in the briefcase to attack Madam X!
trap.win: Miss X is pleased that you disarmed the briefcase!

mmex1.end: Thanks for your help! Take your reward, you've earned it!

mmex2.name: The Merchant Traitor
mmex2.begin: It seems that there's a traitor in the king's court. This traitor passes his information using a merchant who visits Dinotown from time to time. Arrest the merchant and bring him here so I can interrogate him!

search1.name: Find The Merchant
search1.text: You have found a suspicious-looking merchant who seems to match the description...

attack1.name: Fighhhht!
attack1.win: After questioning it seems that this merchant was in fact innocent! Poor man.

search2.name: Find The Merchant
search2.text: This time you are certain that you have found the merchant who matches the description...

attack2.name: Fighhhht!
attack2.win: You've captured the merchant! Take him to Miss X!

mmex2.end: Thanks for arresting this traitor! Don't worry, I know how to make him confess!! But I hope that you were not wrong about this person...

mmex3.name: Police Chase
mmex3.begin: I've received a police report saying that a Dinoz has been attacking merchants in Dinotown. Can you investigate this strange case for me?

portrait.name: Facial Composite Image
portrait.text: The Facial Composite of the suspected Dinoz looks a lot like one of your Dinoz. Coincidence or conspiracy?

investigate.name: Investigate
investigate.begin: While you are searching for clues, angry merchants attack your Dinoz!
investigate.win: This situation is becoming far too complicated ... maybe it's better to just explain everything to Miss X?

madameX.name: Miss X
madameX.text: ...(you explain the entire story)... What? So it really was your Dinoz they were looking for?! Mmmm... I understand. But it will take me some time for me to bury this case. In the meantime, go and hide in the Precipitous Hills!

wait.name: Wait
wait.text: You wait to hear from Miss X...

messagemx.name: Message MX
messagemx.text: A message signed "MX" is waiting for you. It reads "Return to Dinotown as soon as possible"

merchant.name: Merchant
merchant.text: So you are the master of the famous twin?!? Ha ha ha! That's right! Your Dinoz looks just like the one we caught yesterday! Yeah, the real culprit was captured by the Elite Royal Police. You don't have to worry anymore!

mmex3.end: I've successfully covered you for this time, using my connections, but if you ever make a mistake like that again during a mission, I will have to disown you, understand?

mmex4.name: Island it's Cool
mmex4.begin: We've found a group of people growing illegal drugs in the Sticky Swamp. They then export them to the capital. We need someone to go and investigate. This means you must go to the Atlanteid Islands.

investigate.name: Investigate
investigate.text: Following the strong scent and the Djembe sounds, you find a group delinquents with long, greasy hair.

fight.name: Fight them
fight.begin: Aarrg!! A Borg! I think we need to fight together this time!!
fight.win: After having defeated them, the three delinquants want to talk with you...

jeanH1.name: Jean-Hubert
jeanH1.text: Yo man! I understand that you don't really like what we're doing here, but it's all cool. So don't abuse us, man!

charlesE.name: Charles Edward
charlesE.text: Hey man! You're not a bad fighter! But you need to chill out. Cops annoy me and the beach is so cool!

louisS1.name: Louis Stanislas
louisS1.text: My friends wanted to show their gratitude, and ask humbly if we can make a plea deal to avoid the horrors of prison. These horrors will make us waste what all the poets refer to as "our most beautiful years"!

madameX1.name: Miss X
madameX1.text: WHAT? You sympathize with these outlaws? ... I'm not so sure you'll be a good agent after all ... Even if they are nice, they've broken the law. They need to be punished!

madameX2.name: Miss X
madameX2.text: Due to your insistance, I'll make arrangements so that they're granted mitigating circumstances. But they'll still be required to perform community service, comprising tasks such as organising books in the University Library. Will you help them since you're such a big fan of theirs!

louisS2.name: Louis Stanislas
louisS2.text: Thank you so much for keeping us out of prison. We'd be happy to organise the University Library, especially with you there at our side to help us!

organize.name: Organize the Library
organize.text: Your Dinoz helps Jean-Hubert, Charles-Edouard and Louis-Stanislas to organize the University's huge library...

jeanH2.name: Jean-Hubert
jeanH2.text: Thanks a lot man! We gonna go back to the Islands now! We promise we won't mess around again! Ciao!!

mmex4.end: The law is the law. All violations must be punished.

mmex5.name: The Ashpouk Conspiracy
mmex5.begin: Recently we've seen a rise in the trafficking of fake relics from Ashpouk. We need your Dinoz to go to the Big All-Hot and investigate.

informer.name: The Informer
informer.text: I'm responsible for gathering information for Madam X here. We've been informed that strange things occur at night near the Ashpouk Ruins...

hide1.name: Hide
hide1.text: Your Dinoz hides, and prepares to follow possible suspects.

suspects1.name: Suspects!
suspects1.text: Your Dinoz has located the suspects. They seem to gather earth from the Ashpouk Ruins and store it in large bags... You decide to follow them to find out why.

stalking2.name: Stalking
stalking2.text: It seems the suspects have spotted us, they've disappeared...

suspects2.name: Suspects!
suspects2.text: You recognise one of the suspects in a street near the Lavapit!

search.name: Search
search.text: After defeating the suspect, you find many little bags filled with earth from the ruins as well as an access card with the name of "El Signor Don Fuego". Report to Miss X!

madameX.name: Miss X
madameX.text: El Signor Don Fuego? That's a funny coincidence ... He is one of the most famous Lavapit merchants, and he has many connections in the Court. In order to expose him, we need to find proof that directly implicates him!

hide2.name: Stakeout
hide2.text: Grandpa Der'hik used to always say, "A stakeout is the most boring part of the job...". Now you understand why...

suspects3.name: Suspects!
suspects3.text: Some suspiscious looking men arrive and talk with the merguez seller, they leave soon after...

merguezSeller.name: Merguez Seller
merguezSeller.text: What did the tourists want you ask? They just wanted to use my new Bread-Oven which I use to make my Goblin Sandwiches... apparently they use it to heat pottery. They went to the Lavapit to take it to their boss.

suspects4.name: Suspects!
suspects4.text: You recognise the three suspects in a street near the Lavapit!

challenge2.name: Challenge Them!
challenge2.win: After defeating the suspects, they admit that they made fake relics with the earth from the Ashpouk Ruins! You better take them to Miss X...

mmex5.end: Great! I will make sure that they testify against Don Fuego. Great timing, he was becoming far too rich and powerful in the Court ... Thanks for your help as always!

elma.name: The Master's Shopping
elma.begin: You can start doing my shopping now, that will teach you a lesson... I need some water, embers, fish, bread and some fresh mushrooms!

water.name: Draw Some Water
water.text: You've drawn some water for the Elemental Master

ember.name: Gather Hot Embers
ember.text: You've gathered some hot embers for the Elemental Master

fish.name: Buy a Fish
fish.text: You've bought some fresh fish for the Elemental Master. Now you only need to get some bread and mushrooms...

bread.name: Buy Bread
bread.text: You've bought a warm bread for the Elemental Master

smashroom.name: Pick Up Smashroom Pieces
smashroom.text: You've picked up some Smashrooms pieces, yummy! The shopping list of the Elemental Master is now complete!

elmalightning.name: Lesson 1 - Lightning
elmalightning.begin: Because you're so persistent, I'll try to teach you the basics of the easiest element to comprehend, Lightning. But looking at your level, you must go and study at the University first...

study.name: Study Lightning
study.text: Lightning is the easiest element to catch, but is difficult to keep. Only Dinoz with the Lightning Conductor skill can do it...

study2.text: Most of the books on this subject were written by the Elemental Master! To understand Lightning, his advice is: "go to the peak of the Big All-Hot on a stormy day to directly experiment with it .... and survive .... or at least try to!".

experiment.name: Experiment With Lightning
experiment.win: You survived! According to the books of the Elemental Master, you now have a better understanding of lightning...

elmalightning.elmaTalk: This is the second part of the training. Go to the Swamp and kill 3 Eeloz in order to study how their skin generates electricity!

eeloz.name: Study Eeloz Skin
eeloz.text: The Master was right! After having inspected the Eeloz skin, you can see hundreds of « Minilec »: these little bugs naturally generate Lightning energy! You now have a far better knowledge of lightning...

elmalightning.end: Ah! you're back! Well, your knowledge isn't perfect, but much improved nonetheless...

elmafire.name: Lesson 2 - Fire
elmafire.begin: Fire... an element which has always fascinated mankind! It's one of the simplest elements to comprehend...
elmafire.elmaTalk1: This is the best location at which to learn more about the Fire element. You must begin by killing the Venerable, after you have killed him we'll then discuss the element...

venerable.name: Kill the Venerable
venerable.text: Just as you were about to attack the Venerable, with death being inevitable, you receive a message from the Elemental Master asking you to return.

elmafire.elmaTalk2: If I asked you to jump off a cliff would you do it? Unbelievable! Don't play with fire! Talking of fire, I think cooking a Flamelet compote would be good training.
elmafire.elmaTalk3: Flamelets personify the Fire element. Paradoxically, they feed on Air and have the capacity to divide themselves into other Flamelets. When you're least expecting it, Fire can do a lot of damage in battle. But if you learn how to use it, it becomes harmless. Like Flamelets...
elmafire.elmaTalk4: You shouldn't get carried away: Flamelets were only a warm up. Now you must start the real exercises... I don't think you'll be fantastic, but you seek death at any cost...
elmafire.elmaTalk5: Now you need to go to see the Pignight Brothers at the Ashpouk Ruins. They borrowed my Super-Invulnerability-Pepper a few years ago but still haven't given it back... crush them and bring back my Pepper as soon as possible!

pignfight.name: Fight the Pignight Brothers
pignfight.begin: The Pignight Brothers are softpig twins. They are particularly gifted in Fire mastery...
pignfight.win: You have defeated the Pignight Brothers! Their cavern is now open...

search.name: Search the Cavern
search.text: After searching for hours, you finally come across a strange-looking Pepper you've never seen before... It gleams in the dark and seems to possess a magical power...

elmafire.end: Ah! You've found Super-Invulnerability-Pepper! I'll finally be able to prepare my Super-Piperade!

elmawood.name: Lesson 3 - Wood
elmawood.begin: Wood element. An underestimated yet powerful element.
elmawood.elmaTalk1: Hey, wood reminds me something ... A long time ago, I went to the Monster's Secret Island. Strange creatures called Vegetox gather there. They are half-animal and half-vegetable, and masters of the Wood element! Maybe one day you'll be able to go there... hold on! I haven't even given you my instructions yet, what was I thinking!
elmawood.elmaTalk2: Well, anyway! In order to learn more about the Wood element, you must go to Grumhel Forest, although it's a bit far away. It would be better to learn the basics in a place nearby.
elmawood.elmaTalk3: I heard that a mysterious group, the Korgon Avengers as they liked to be called, have succeeded in entering the Big All-Hot through the Tunnel under the Branch. Go and see what's going on and keep me informed, as I don't really want to venture there...

find.name: Find Out
find.text: A group of 5 Korgon Avengers was seen coming out of the Tunnel. It seems they were heading to Lavapit.

elmawood.elmaTalk4: What did he say? Of course I know that's where they were going! Those damned Korgons stole my Wand of Cursed-Wood. I don't know what they want to do with it, but we have to get it back as soon as possible! He has to deal with them, they fled toward the South!

fight1.name: Fight the Korgon Avengers
fight1.begin: While you were approaching, the 5 Korgon Avengers split in two groups: two of them flee and three stay fight...
fight1.win: Where did the rest of the group escape to?

korven.name: Korgon Avengers
korven.text: An Island resident assures you that he saw two Korgon Avengers. It seems they were running for their life to the West, and they were carrying a strange Wooden Wand.

fight2.name: Fight the Korgon Avengers
fight2.begin: You have finally caught up with the chief of the Korgon Avengers, The Masked Korgon!
fight2.win: You have defeated the Korgon Avengers!!!

wand.name: Pick Up The Magic Wand
wand.text: This strange-looking Wand seems to possess powers that are beyond belief... It's better to take it back to it's owner as soon as possible before it claims more victims!

elmawood.end: Ah! My Wand! Well done! Those damned Korgons! If you find that you suffer from side effects, come back later...

elmaair.name: Lesson 4 - Air
elmaair.begin: When something disappears, air takes it's place. With this element, everything is a question of density!
elmaair.elmaTalk1: The Air element is not particularly well-known in Dinotown. Due to the fact that the Big All-Hot and the Atlanteid Islands are very close by, it's much easier to study the Fire and Water elements. I had to go all the way to Caushemesh in order to complete my studies on this subject...
elmaair.elmaTalk2: But instead of asking you to venture that far away, I'm going to ask you to do me a favour... you must bring me the scrolls which have been found during the recent development work in Dinoplaza. I would like to study them in depth...

scrolls.name: Find the Scrolls
scrolls.text: A resident explains to you that these scrolls were found during the recent excavations, but only a true Master could decipher them...

fight1.name: Return the Scrolls
fight1.begin: As you are about to return the scrolls to the Elemental Master, you are ambushed!
fight1.win: In the confusion of battle, someone has stolen the precious scrolls!

elmaair.elmaTalk3: What?! You lost the scrolls? What incompetence! You have no idea of how precious they are! You have to find them again! The thieves can't be that far away...

fight2.name: Scroll Thieves
fight2.begin: You find an accomplice of the Scroll Thieves...
fight2.win: You've recovered one page of the Scroll .... Where can the others be!

fight3.name: Scroll Thieves
fight3.begin: You find the leader of the Scroll Thieves...
fight3.win: This thief has two pages of the Scroll in his possession. You have found three out of the four pages, the last one seems to have disappeared, maybe this will be enough for the Master?

elmaair.elmaTalk4: I need a few moments to study the scrolls...
elmaair.elmaTalk5: ....Well, I've finished. It's an incredible discovery: these scrolls speak of a "Dragon Island". According to legend, it is an island with large wings meaning it can change it's location!
elmaair.elmaTalk6: If these scrolls are authentic, this would mean that the Dragon Island really exists .... but there's something strange, the explanation of how to get to the island stops suddenly, it seems one page is missing...
elmaair.elmaTalk7: We won't know more for the moment as we lack the required information... It's a pity, I'd really like to explore this mysterious new island!
elmaair.elmaTalk8: But let's return to our lesson in the Air element... We're losing time! You must bring back 2 units of air energy as soon as possible!
elmaair.elmaTalk9: What? That's all? I asked you to bring back 5 units of air energy! Go and get the other 3!
elmaair.giveAirEnergy2: Give 3 Air Energy and Complete the Quest
elmaair.end: Well, well, well, it seems you can do anything when you put your mind to it!

elmawater.name: Lesson 5 - Water
elmawater.begin: Our last lesson will be to study the Water element...
elmawater.elmaTalk1: I always keep the Water element until the end of the training... to be honest, I don't like studying the Water element at all: it's cold and wet! That's why I live on the Big All-Hot...
elmawater.elmaTalk2: In spite of the fact that I have perfectly mastered the Water element, I'm not in the mood to teach you. Go to Bao who'll train you on my behalf!
elmawater.baoTalk1: Mmmm... So you are the student of the Elemental Master? You arrived just in time, I recently had some leaks on the Portal that I had to take care of. Now there are Monsters who have escaped to the Islands... Can you find them all for me?
elmawater.baoTalk2: Thanks for your help, I can hardly move when the Portal is weakened. It's better for me to stay here in case a powerful monster tries to enter...
elmawater.baoTalk3: I've probably been talking too much... Mmmmm... Let's talk about the Water element.
elmawater.baoTalk4: Water is abundant in the Atlanteid Islands, and it's a powerful element when used against Lightning. Did you know that Lightning is the principal element in the Magnetic Steppes?
elmawater.baoTalk5: Mmmm... Water is very powerful. Due to it's power, it's very popular as it grants the ability to take control of a fighter and to return him to his friends. It's not possible to master it by normal methods, but maybe one day one of your Dinoz will be able to master it?
elmawater.baoTalk6: Mmmm... That's pretty much everything I have to tell you about the Water element. I'll let the Elemental Master know that you've finished your training...
elmawater.elmaTalk3: How is old Bao doing? I've only seen him a few times since he was assigned to Portal guard duty by Mandragora .... well, in any case, it seems your training is complete.
elmawater.end: That's the end of your final lesson. Come and see me for your final reward.

dexplo.name: Secure The Road
dexplo.begin: « WANTED: Mercenary to explore the desert and secure paths. Un-motivated candidates need not apply. »

takeNotesToutemba.name: Take notes
takeNotesToutemba.description: You add the details of this stage to your report. The gorge seems very quiet...

climbCliff.name: Climb the rock face
climbCliff.description: After hours of climbing, you finally reach the Nerheeven plateau. The view is magnificient!

takeMoreNotes.name: Take more notes
takeMoreNotes.begin: While you are sitting down taking some more notes, a group of bandits ambushes you!
takeMoreNotes.win: Woooh, that was close! You have to report the bandits to the Outpost...

dexplo.end: While you are reading your report, you notice a worried look on the merchants' faces. Some rush to write down new announcements at the Office.

dcarav.name: Western Caravan
dcarav.begin: « The Merchants Association are looking for a transporter to make a routine delivery, Desert raiders need not apply. Contact the quatermaster Kalift Medat for more information. »

soulefMoissaStart.text: Mission order 51... Ok. For the caravan, take delivery of the tool crate at the Crakling Frontier. It's south of here. Next!

carrier.name: Carrier
carrier.text: Here are the crates. That's strange, I swear I heard a noise coming from inside the crates... Take them to the Lodestone Pylons in the north!

citadelBreak.name: Take a break
citadelBreak.description: Wow, these crates are really heavy!

deliveryService.name: Delivery service
deliveryService.text: Perfect! But I only need one crate. Send the others to my colleague in Neerhel. Take the route that passes by the lake, it'll be much safer.

syphonBreak.name: Take a break
syphonBreak.description: The weight of the crates is unbearable! You decide to take a little break so you can rest.

suspiciousNoise.name: Suspicious noise
suspiciousNoise.begin: The crates break open with a loud bang! A swarm of angry Korgons come out screaming!
suspiciousNoise.win: It seems that this delivery was smuggling Korgons ... you must inform the Quatermaster right away.
suspiciousNoise.lost: The Korgons are running away! Find them first...

soulefMoissaEnd.text: Korgons you say? Hmmm... I'll make a note of it and take the necessary actions. Go and get your reward.

dcarav.end: Sign your mission report at the Office to get your reward.

scorp1.name: Zest of Scorpwink
scorp1.begin: « A daring Pharmacist is looking for Scorpwink Stingers in good condition for use in scientific experiments. A good knowledge of fish would be a big plus. »

soulefMoissa.text: Stingers? Again? Go to the Devourer of the East. Scorpwinks breed there amongst rocks.

searchScorpwink.name: Search for a Scorpwink
searchScorpwink.begin: It doesn't take long to come face to face with a Scorpwink...
searchScorpwink.win: Unfortunately, the stinger did not survive the battle shock. You'll need to find another one in better condition.

searchFurther.name: Search again
searchFurther.begin: With difficulty you finally reach the top of the rock heap ... but then fall on a Scorpwink fighting an Earthworm! They both turn and jump on you!

collectStinger.name: Pick up the stinger
collectStinger.description: You pick up a Scorpwink stinger.

scorp1.end: You give the stinger to the Quatermaster. He will take it to the pharmacist.

brig1.name: Secure The Crossroads
brig1.begin: « The Consortium of Rascals is recruiting! If you're young, in good health and like rewarding missions, this quest is for you. Speak to Ali Babwa, the scout. »

aliLabah.text: So you're the one they've sent to clean up this mess. We want you to make sure that the Nonmagus Crossroads is safe. Follow the road to south. Once you're attacked, you'll know you're in the right place!

brig1.end: The Consortion knows how to reward their allies. Here's a reward for your troubles!

kitchn.name: The Greedy Thief
kitchn.begin: « Fast Dinoz wanted for a small job at the Citadel. Please contact Malika Ramhel, the cook. »

guardStart.text: Malika is in the palace kitchens at the back, on the left.

malikaRamhel.name: Malika Ramhel
malikaRamhel.startText: Thanks for replying to my post! A sly dog has been stealing all our food for the past several days... this must stop, you must find the culprit.
malikaRamhel.endText: Wow. Our Citadel isn't what it once was. Everybody comes and goes as they please! Either they're crying or they're fighting, it's just not what it once was... thanks anyway. GO and get your reward from the Rocky Outpost.

enterStoreroom.name: Go to the stockroom
enterStoreroom.description: No one here. You decide to hide your Dinoz in the shadows...

waitInShadows.name: Wait in the shadows
waitInShadows.begin: After a couple of minutes, you hear a noise coming closer ... it's a scorpwink! He's holding some food between his claws!
waitInShadows.win: The scorpwink fled into the Citadel maze!

chaseScorpwink.name: Follow the scorpwink
chaseScorpwink.begin: >Why does he come back without anything? ... Hey! ... Look! An intruder!

kitchn.end: An agent at the outpost welcomes you without a smile and gives you your reward, things really aren't what they used to be.

worms.name: Dewormer
worms.begin: « The East Carapaths Company is looking for a maintenance worker to take care of their public roads. Contact supervisor Yousshoud Go'qwuik at the Crakling Frontier construction site for more information. »

fadoua.name: Supervisor Yousshoud Go'qwuik
fadoua.startText: You there! What are you doing on my construction site without a protective helmet?!
fadoua.briefingText: You're the maintenance worker? Well. We have some problems up north with Earthwork attacks on the path to the Lodestone Pylons. You want to do me a favour? Go and clean up the area.
fadoua.endText: A Matriarch... that isn't a good sign. I hope your intervention will have calmed the situation...... for now. Thanks for your help!

takeHelmet.name: Take a helmet
takeHelmet.description: You put on a work helmet.

worker.name: Carapaths worker
worker.startText: Ah, at last some help! We suffered another Earthworm attack this morning. It stops us from working! On top of that, they destroy the roads we've built with the holes that they leave behind...
worker.holeText: Thanks for your help! But ... What's that noise?! ... Look! A huge hole has opened up in the ground!
worker.endText: I thought we were going to die! ... Thanks for your help, the Carapaths will reward you! See you later!

worms.end: The East Carapaths Company thanks you for your help on our contruction site.

brig2.name: Wanted: Sahalami The Slicer
brig2.begin: « WANTED: Sahalami "the Slicer". This person is EXTREMELY DANGEROUS. He's wanted for countless acts of piracy. There are no clues about his whereabouts. This mission comes with a HUGE REWARD! Low-level Dinoz need not apply! »

attackedCaravan.name: Damaged caravan
attackedCaravan.description: You find the rest of a caravan that seems to have been recently attacked...

brig2.findBandits: Find the raider near the Syphon

stackedCrates.name: Stacked crates
stackedCrates.description: You notice various objects, which appear to be stolen, stacked at the entrance of a murky cavern... Maybe the culprits are hiding inside?

exploreHideout.name: Explore the den
exploreHideout.begin: Hey hey?... Look who followed us!... Get him!
exploreHideout.win: You have defeated Sahalami the Slicer!

strangePendant.name: Strange pendant
strangePendant.description: Sahalami wore a pendant shaped like a cleaver. Strange...

brig2.end: Sahalami won't scare anyone anymore. But you must solve the mystery of this pendant...

penden.name: A Mysterious Pendant
penden.begin: The cleaver-shaped pendant found on Sahalami is very mysterious ... you should look into it.

soulefMoissa.text: This pendant means nothing to me. Sorry.

aliLabah.text: Ah!! I've seen this pendant before on the neck of certain chiefs on my travels. It seems that some thief clans joined their forces! Here is the list of the chief names in question.

takeList.name: Take the list
takeList.description: You obtain the names of many bandit chiefs. They are probably related to this thieves association!

penden.end: You have obtained the information you needed.

hunt1.name: Wanted: Trip The Wimp
hunt1.begin: « Wanted: Trip, the wimpy raider of the moonless nights. The latest reports talk of an attack at the bottom of the north Devourer. This mission is HIGHLY DANGEROUS, a generous reward can be expected. »

waitForAttack.name: Wait for an attack
waitForAttack.description: You decide to set a trap at the bottom of the Devourer and wait...

wait.name: Wait...
wait.description: You wait for hours but nothing happens.

passingMerchant.name: Passing merchant
passingMerchant.text: Are you looking for Trip? I haven't seen him today, which is a good thing!

waitAgain.name: Wait again...
waitAgain.description: You start to walk in circles to pass the time........nothing has happened

keepWaiting.name: Continue to wait
keepWaiting.description: More hours pass, yet still nothing!

passingAdventurer.name: A passing adventurer
passingAdventurer.text: Trip?... Never heard of him, sorry. Have a good day!

walkInCircles.name: Walk in a circle
walkInCircles.description: You start to become exhausted, and that's the only interesting thing that has happened so far...

waitLonger.name: Wait a bit longer...
waitLonger.win: You spot Trip, hiding behind his men a few feet away from you...

tripou.name: Trip
tripou.taunt: You are no match for me! Go away!

chargeTripou.name: Attack Trip!
chargeTripou.begin: You are brave, but not brave enough ... It's time to end this!
chargeTripou.win: You defeat Trip the Wimp, raider of the moonless nights!

cleaverPendant.name: Cleaver pendant
cleaverPendant.description: Trip was wearing one of the pendants you were looking for.

hunt2.name: Wanted: Boukanee The Immortal
hunt2.begin: « Wanted: Boukanee, the immortal torturer of the abyss! He is hiding in his lair in the Far West. This mission is EXTREMELY DANGEROUS! »

findBoukane.name: Find Boukanee
findBoukane.begin: Aaah! It's not me! It's not me! If you are looking for Boukanee, he left with his gang for the Citadel... Please, let me go!
findBoukane.win: Hmmm... This thief talked of the Citadel... I should go and have a look there myself.

guard.startText: Boukanee? Here? Nope it's impossible. Feel free to take a look if you think he's here.
guard.cellarText: You've found him? Bah, you can check the caves if you want but nobody goes there.
guard.endText: Gee... Boukanee... Here... Luckily you were here!

searchHall.name: Search the hall
searchHall.description: It seems that there's nobody here...

searchRoof.name: Go up to the roof
searchRoof.description: Nice sight! But Boukanee isn't here either ... We should continue to search the Citadel.

enterCellar.name: Enter the cave
enterCellar.begin: Shhhht, someone is coming... Raah, we've been spotted! We can't let them get away!
enterCellar.win: You have defeated Boukanee the immortal and his gang!

cleaverPendant.name: Cleaver pendant
cleaverPendant.description: Boukanee wore one of the pendants you are searching for. Another one down!

hunt2.end: You have foiled Boukanee's plans. It seems he was planning to attack the Citadel.

hunt3.name: Wanted: Cervelah The Poisoner
hunt3.begin: « WANTED: Cervelah, the green poisoner. Tall with brown-hair, Cervelah wears a hood and is always accompanied by Stingoz, his loyal Scorpwink. Cervelah is extremely hostile. The Consortium of Rascals have put a HUGE BOUNTY on his head! Contact merchant Gimal Yurqoins at the pylons. »

aboulTonhor.name: Gimal Yurqoins
aboulTonhor.text: Cervelah? Yup, I know him! His horrible Scorpwink bit me when they tried to rob me... I was sick for weeks! I've heard that he and his gang hide somewhere in the south.

hunt3.findAttackers: Find the attacker of Gimal Yurqoins

noiseBehindRocks.name: Noise behind the rocks
noiseBehindRocks.description: You move forward towards the noise source and discover a small group of raiders feasting on the lakeside... Get into position for an attack!

attackCamp.name: Attack the camp
attackCamp.win: No traces of Cervelah... he must be nearby...

circleSyphon.name: Take a look around the Syphon
circleSyphon.begin: Hold this dinoz, I'm going to inform Cervelah !
circleSyphon.win: You have to find this bandit.

searchFugitive.name: Search for the coward
searchFugitive.description: Nobody here. But you notice steep tracks heading toward the Neerheeven plateau...

climb.name: Climb
climb.begin: Chief! Chief! He's here! He found us... Kill him!
climb.win: What a fight! You've defeated Cervelah the poisoner and his loyal Stingoz.

cleaverPendant.name: Cleaver pendant
cleaverPendant.description: Cervelah wore one of the cleaver pendants you were searching for...

hunt3.end: The Consortium of Rascals thanks you for your help. Here's a nice reward for your efforts.

move.name: Voyage of Discovery
move.begin: Welcome to Dinoland, I'm going to teach you how to travel around the green wilderness of these parts, brace yourself... Try to lake it to the University and I'll speak to you there!
move.end: Mitchell Starr seems impressed, he gives you an Irma's potion as a gift, this gives you an extra move!

guideMichel.text: Bravo, you made it, all you need to do now is confirm that you've completed the mission by meeting me in Dinotown again

madameSeyche.name: Madam Squyd
madameSeyche.text: Well played! Let's move on to the next one.

atk.name: Dangerous Battle
atk.begin: You had to fight before to get to the University, now, you're going to fight right here!
atk.end: Excellent, you've killed all the monsters on your own! You will meet many of them as you carry out missions and explore! The more you exlpore, the more powerful you become!

boutik.name: One Step Beyond
boutik.begin: Now you're going to buy an Angel Potion at the flying shop, this potion revives your Dinoz if they are overcome by injuries sustained when fighting monsters! To do this, simply click on the "Shop" button at the top left of the interface. You can then give me the object you have bought!
boutik.end: Congratulations! You have successfully used the shop, and it can be accessed from wherever you are in the game, Don't hesitate to use it if need be!

texts.fightMegawolf: As you approach, a gigantic wolf appears!
texts.fightStarFound: After the battle, you spot a shiny object: it's one of the 7 magical stars!
texts.eatStarFound: After eating the Pie, your Dinoz notices something sparkling a few meters away... Congratulations! You've found one of the 7 magical stars!
texts.digStarFound: With the very first strike of your shovel, you hear a strange noise. After digging a little deeper, you discover one of the 7 magical stars! Congratulations!
texts.resurrectStarFound: As your Dinoz wakes up in Dinoville, it realizes that someone has entrusted it with the final magical star! Its memories are hazy, but it recalls strange Dinoz unlike any it has ever seen before, resembling monkeys with multicolored fur... They're the ones who gave it the 7th star, but who are they?!?

texts.tower_won: You've taken control of the Devourer! Hold on to it until midnight to earn its precious seeds!
texts.grains_credited: Congratulations! Your control of the Devourers has earned you ::count:: seed(s), which have been added to your Ingredients.
texts.stop_defend_tower: You've relinquished control of the Devourer.
