journal.linkCopied: The replay link has been copied to your clipboard.

texts.initialAmbush: As you approach the Whistling Siphon, three members of Team W suddenly appear and attack your group!
texts.initialAmbushRescue: Wait! This Dinoz is far too weak to be part of King Rocky's elite troops... We must have mistaken you for someone else. Please forgive us!
texts.fightWTeamStart: As you approach, a Dinoz from Team W appears... You attack!
texts.fightWTeamWon1: Why are you attacking us? We'll get our revenge!
texts.fightWTeamWon2: You must be spies working for King Rocky! You'll pay for this!
texts.fightWTeamWon3: Are you trying to wipe us out?!? Quick! Let's take refuge in the southern camp!
texts.fightWTeamEnd: Wait! Bigbeastly isn't himself... Since you've followed us all the way here, let's stop fighting for a moment and talk like civilized people...
texts.fightDarkDinoz: As you enter the Magnetic Steppes, strange shadows suddenly surround you. It looks like you've walked straight into an ambush...
texts.fightPotionStolen: This is a disaster! Those strange, enraged Smashrooms have stolen your Anti-Sehd Potion!
texts.fightSkingStart: You recognize Bigbeastly, the Wanwan from Team W... He seems to be under the control of the Dark Smashroom... But are they really intelligent enough to pull this off on their own???
texts.fightCaptainHelp: Looks like you could use a little help... Team W: ATTAAAAACK!
texts.fightSkingEnd1: After the battle, you find the Anti-Sehd Potion you prepared lying on the ground. You use it on Bigbeastly to bring him back to his senses...
texts.fightSkingEnd2: The King of the Rockys and the Captain are waiting to thank you for your courageous battle...
texts.syphonDeath: As your Dinoz attempts to cross the Siphon, a powerful magnetic discharge strikes it head-on. Without protection, it instantly collapses...

reportModal.title: Report
reportModal.reportingForumMessage: You are reporting a message from

dinoz.title: Adopting a Dinoz
dinoz.begin: Welcome to DinoRPG. I'll be your guide for the first few steps. First of all, you need to get yourself a Dinoz! Take your time to choose one you really like, as they'll be with you for a while.
dinoz.end: Congratulations! Now let's get involved - I'll show you around a little part of this vast universe!

helpers.compare: Take a look at the skills and characteristics of each one! We'll learn more about these later!
helpers.name: Good choice! Now you need to give your Dinoz a name!

speak.title: Overheated Discussion
speak.begin: Welcome to Dinoland, I'm going to teach you how to speak to the characters in the game! If you are stuck, click on the New Action button! Click on Michael the Guide (that's me!) in the actions area, which you'll find underneath your dinoz.
speak.end: You have just spoken to your first Dinoland resident. You'll meet many, many more in the course of your adventures here!

move.title: The gateway to adventure
move.begin: It is now time to discover some new places.If you are stuck, click on the New Action button! In the Map section, choose your destination by clicking on one of the flashing places, and be ready for adventure! I would advise you to go to the Fountain of Youth first of all.
move.end: Congratulations, you have made it to a new place in Dinoland! There are loads of places to discover, and one day you'll have seen them all, the soul of an adventure is dormant within you!

helpers.combat: When you move around, you will meet all kinds of monsters. Your Dinoz will fight alone, and as you progress, you should train it and teach it the most powerful skills!

port.title: Go to Frish Port
port.begin: Your Dinoz feels great, and it will have to if it wants to traverse the lands of this vast Kingdom. Set out for Frish Port. You can chat to the locals there and maybe you can learn more about the world in which you have arrived!
port.end: There you are - Frish Port! (Oh Yeah...)

pub.title: Live the adventure
pub.begin: Chat to the locals there and maybe you can learn more about the world in which you have arrived!
pub.end: Follow baobob on this new adventure, you're sure to learn a lot...

baobob.title: Follow Bao Bob
baobob.end: Follow baobob on this new adventure, you're sure to learn a lot...

helpers.skill: You have levelled up! It is now time for you to choose a new skill to teach your Dinoz. Choose carefully! These choices will shape your companion's destiny.
helpers.heal: Use a Cloud Burger to get your strength back before you continue your adventure.

papy.title: Help to make the world a better place
papy.begin: The time has come for your first mission, Go and see Papy Joe at his home on the other side of the university, he'll surely have some missions for you. Go to Papy Joe's house and accept your first mission! Above your actions, you will see the steps required to complete the mission so you always know where you are!
papy.end: Congratulations, you have accepted your first mission. Completing missions is important to advance in DinoRPG. Over and above missions, some characters will accompany you on adventures, and incredible quests which will lead you to new locations and terrifying monsters!

helpers.mission: Choose a mission from those available

shop.title: Purchasing power
shop.begin: Once you have used up all your objects, you can use the gold which you have earned in combat to buy more! Click on the shop button, at the top left, just underneath your gold coin total. This will take you to the shop, now all you have to do is choose... a cloud burger for example!
shop.end: Good, your purchase will now appear in your inventory!

burger.title: Somewhat peckish
burger.begin: During combats, your Dinoz loses health points. To heal it, you need to use objects. For example, using a cloud burger on your dinoz will restore health points.
burger.end: Good, you have restore some of your Dinoz' health points, your adventure can continue.

helpers.burger: Click here to use the object.

clan.title: All-Powerful Clans
clan.begin: You are almost ready to set out on adventure. If you feel a bit lonely or don't really know what to do, I'd recommend you to join a clan where you can discuss your adventures and exchange advice with other Dinoz masters.
clan.end: You will find the best Dinoz masters in clans which take part in ferocious battles in the Clan Wars and Championships of the Clans.

user.title: Look inside yourself
user.begin: Did you know that you can access all your details by going to the My Account page? In the right-hand menu, you will see a My Account which allows you to see all your public information, your dinoz, your titles and your Epic Rewards!
user.end: Don't forget that you can edit all your information by clicking on the Modify my Information button!

end.title: End
end.begin: Wnd there you have it, I'm going to leave you to discover your own path now, but if you need me, you can come and talk to me any time at Dinotown, I'm always there to help out!
end.end: I wish you a long and exciting adventure throughout the universe of Dinoland! Good luck Dinoz Master!

reward.title: Christmas Rewards
reward.content:
Congratulations on taking part in the Christmas event! As a thank-you for your heroic efforts against the Piglous, your rewards have been added directly to your inventory.

{items}

Thank you for participating!
Santa Joël
